label: DGU at a Glance
html:
DGU at a Glance Approvals & Accreditation Rankings & Recognition
Established 2008 · Dehradun, Uttarakhand

DBS Global University

Formerly Doon Business School — Shaping future-ready leaders for 17 years

The University is approved by the University Grants Commission (UGC) under Section 22 & 2(f) and is notified and listed by the State Government of Uttarakhand under the Uttarakhand Private University Act 2023 Section (7) Sub Section (1), and is a proud member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU).

Over the past 17 years, DBS has built a strong reputation for excellence through its flagship Business Administration programs (BBA and MBA) and has now expanded into a full-fledged university (granted university status in 2024). The University has 300+ employees and 3,000+ students, offering a wide array of interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary programs across Engineering, Media, Law, Agriculture, Pharmacy, Liberal Arts and Management, with approvals from BCI (Bar Council of India) and PCI (Pharmacy Council of India).

Led by the visionary President, Mr. Mohit Aggarwal, the University is committed to offering programs that prioritize skill development, industry relevance, and experiential learning. Every program is designed in collaboration with leading industry partners and is enriched with value-added certifications such as SAP, SAS Six Sigma, NISM, ACCA, ICA, Alteryx, HCL Tech, and more — ensuring that students graduate as industry-ready professionals. To promote future-ready education, all programs integrate AI-embedded learning, contemporary tools, and 21st-century skills. Students are encouraged to grow beyond academics and think beyond conventional boundaries by actively participating in more than 25+ student-led clubs and committees, fostering leadership, creativity, collaboration, and holistic development.

At its core, DBS Global University stands for innovation, integrity, and inspiration.

Mission & Vision

Mission

  • Deliver high-quality education that aligns with global standards of accreditations and rankings.
  • Embrace and integrate emerging technologies and innovative practices to prepare students with skills for the future.
  • Promote inclusivity, ethics, and global awareness to equip graduates for addressing complex challenges and driving positive change.
  • Cultivate a peer learning and collaborative environment that fosters personal, academic, and societal progress.

Vision

To be globally recognized for delivering quality education and embracing emerging technologies & innovation, while empowering future leaders to shape a sustainable and progressive world.

DBS Global University — Innovation · Integrity · Inspiration

label: The City Dehradun - How to Reach
html:
DBS is located in picturesque location in Dehradun, capital of the newly formed state of Uttarakhand which is about 250 kms. north east of the national capital city of New Delhi. Dehradun is well connected by road and rail. There is also an airstrip located at Jolly Grant about 21 kms. from the main city. from the main city, and 1.5 km from the highway (Dehradun-Delhi).

How to Reach Dehradun

By Road

  • From Delhi/North India:
    Dehradun is well-connected by road, particularly via National Highway 7 (NH-7) and the new Delhi-Dehradun Economic Corridor (NH-307), making car travel efficient.
  • Buses:
    Regular buses run from Delhi's ISBT Kashmiri Gate and other cities in Uttarakhand.
  • Taxis/Cabs:
    Private taxis and car rentals are easily available from Delhi, Haridwar, and within Uttarakhand.
  • Local Transport:
    Taxis, autos, and shared autos (like Route No. 5) are available from the ISBT.

By Train

  • Dehradun Railway Station (DDN):
    This station is a major hub, linking Dehradun to cities like Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, and Lucknow.
  • From Delhi:
    Popular trains include Shatabdi Express, Mussoorie Express, and Vande Bharat Express, offering daily connectivity.

By Air

  • Jolly Grant Airport (DED):
    This is Dehradun's nearest airport, about 25 km from the city center.
  • Flights:
    Flights are available from major Indian cities, but can be expensive. Connecting via Delhi is a common strategy.
  • Airport Transfer:
    From Jolly Grant, you can take taxis, auto-rickshaws, or shared cabs to Dehradun.

label: The Visitor
html:
Governor of Uttarakhand

Retirement - January 31, 2016
Date of Birth - 1 February 1956
Birthplace- Jalal Usman, Amritsar, Punjab
Early education - Sainik School, Kapurthala, Punjab

Lt. Gen. Gurmeet Singh, distinguished for his military prowess and expertise in the Indian Army, currently serves as the Governor of Uttarakhand. Mr. Singh's personality is a remarkable blend of valor, bravery, courage, kindness, compassion, simplicity, and honesty. His ideals truly entitle him to prestige and respect. His life reflects a remarkable combination of simplicity, simplicity, and fame, combined with his impressive personality.

A master at making tough decisions in military life, Mr. Singh is broad-minded, gentle in spirit, heart, and thoughts. He is compassionate, loving, and affectionate towards all.

He possesses a vision that sees only the soul and the Supreme Being, forgetting caste, religion, and class. Having fully embraced the three Sikh virtues of compassion, simplicity, and honesty in his personal life, Mr. Gurmeet Singh possesses a unique blend of military acumen and a gentle personality. He touches everyone's heart deeply. Since becoming the Governor of Uttarakhand, he has already clarified his patriotism and vision of serving the state in his first message. It would not be an exaggeration to say that Shri Gurmeet Singh Ji's dedicated and dutiful personality is a heritage of our nation.

The philosophy, values, and lifestyle of such individuals will be a unique gift to the current generation. His personality and thinking are based on the path shown by Guru Nanak Dev Ji and Guru Gobind Singh Ji's "Nishay Kar Apni Jeet Karun."

Lt. Gen. Gurmeet Singh
PVSM, UYSM, AVSM, VSM (Retd.)
Former Deputy Chief of Army Staff

Let's learn about this rare personality, his deep study, diplomatic understanding, and academic qualifications.

Hailing from Amritsar, the city of the Golden Temple, the holiest place in Sikhism, he is a former Deputy Chief of Army Staff of the Indian Army. He comes from a patriotic family. His father, Mohin Singh, served in the Indian Army and his elder brother served in the Indian Air Force. He represented the country on numerous occasions. He held numerous talks with China on border issues in India and visited China seven times to hold talks in cities like Beijing and Shanghai. He demonstrated his diplomatic wisdom to negotiators from a powerful country like China.

He demonstrated his prowess once again by visiting Pakistan for talks on Siachen and other issues, building trust between the two sides. He also engaged in numerous counter-terrorism operations in Jammu and Kashmir and the Northeast.

He is a recognized scholar on defense matters. While serving the country, he taught and researched on various defense-related subjects in India and the United States, including at Jawaharlal Nehru University and the National Defense University, Washington. He conducted research on the India-China border dispute for two years. While serving as Adjutant General of the Army, he worked on human resources. He also held various positions in information technology, human resource management training, manpower policy and planning, recruitment, selection, motivation, morale, health, discipline, legal issues, welfare, rehabilitation, and veterans' issues.

He has a special affection for soldiers, brave warriors and martyrs. He is also the chief patron of the Rashtriya Sainik Sanstha. He has been participating as a defense expert in news programs like Nation First and Jai Hind Journal. During his nearly 40 years of service in the army, he has received 4 President's Awards from the Deputy Chief of Army Staff. Apart from this, he has been honored with Param Vishisht Seva Medal, Uttam Yudh Seva Medal, Ati Vishisht Seva Medal, and Vishisht Seva Medal. During his army service, he has also served the country in the exile of Uttarakhand. It is a matter of pride for the country that such a highly learned Sikh warrior has been appointed as the Governor of Devbhoomi Uttarakhand.

Accreditations and Memberships

DBS Global University is proudly associated with leading global accreditation bodies and international frameworks, reflecting its commitment to excellence in higher education. The University holds membership in the Association of MBAs (AMBA) (UK), AACSB International (USA), and Business Graduates Association (BGA) (UK), International Supply Chain Education Alliance (ISCEA) (USA) underscoring its adherence to globally recognized standards in management education.

In addition, DBS Global University is recognized by QS I-GAUGE (India) under the Institution of Happiness (IoH) for 2025–26, highlighting its focus on student well-being and institutional quality. The University is also an active participant in the Erasmus+ Programme (European Union) and is registered under the European Commission (OID: E104128678), further strengthening its global academic collaborations. Additionally, its association with the Study in India Programme (India) reinforces its position as a preferred destination for international education.

Erasmus+ Registration

DBS Global University (DGU) is proudly registered under the European Commission’s Erasmus+ Programme , reflecting our commitment to international academic collaboration and mobility.

Through Erasmus+, DGU engages in global partnerships that promote student and faculty exchange, joint research, and cross-cultural learning experiences. This affiliation enables our students and staff to participate in funded mobility programs across leading European institutions, enhancing academic exposure and global competencies.

Our Erasmus+ registration ensures that DGU meets the standards set by the European Commission for quality education, transparency, and international cooperation.

location & Campus

Dehradun – An Ideal Student City

DBS Global University is located in Dehradun, a city known for its academic excellence, natural surroundings, and student-friendly environment. The university offers a perfect setting for international students to learn, grow, and experience global education in a safe and inspiring environment.

A Peaceful and Inspiring Environment

Dehradun, nestled in the foothills of the Himalayas, is known for its calm atmosphere, greenery, and pleasant climate. It provides a focused academic environment while ensuring a high quality of life for students.

A Recognized Education Hub

The city is home to some of India’s most reputed educational institutions, making it a well-established destination for students from across the world.

Connectivity and Accessibility

Dehradun is well connected by air, rail, and road. Jolly Grant Airport ensures convenient access to major cities, while Delhi serves as an international gateway for global travel.

Safe and Student-Friendly Lifestyle

The city offers a secure and welcoming environment, ideal for international students. It balances modern infrastructure with a relaxed lifestyle.

Who Can Apply?

At DBS Global University, we welcome applications from:

  • Students holding a passport of any country other than India.
  • Students of Indian origin who have completed their education abroad.
  • Sponsored candidates applying through international pathways.

* Students from SAARC nations and other regions are encouraged to apply and become part of our global campus.

Eligibility Criteria

To apply for international admissions, students must:

  • Meet the academic requirements of the chosen program.
  • Possess a valid passport for the duration of study.
  • Submit required academic transcripts and documents.
  • Demonstrate English language proficiency (if applicable).

* English proficiency tests such as IELTS or TOEFL may be recommended where required.

Pre-Arrival Guidelines

Before arriving in India, students should ensure:

  • Obtain a valid student visa from the Indian Embassy.
  • Carry all original academic documents and offer letter.
  • Arrange travel to India (nearest airport: Dehradun/Delhi).
  • Prepare essentials such as laptop, adapters, and personal items.
  • Inform the university in advance for arrival coordination.

Post-Arrival Support

After arrival, DBS Global University provides full support:

label: International Collaborative Research Program
html:
Joint Doctoral Programme (JDP) with International Universities

DBS Global University offers a Joint Doctoral Programme (JDP) in collaboration with reputed international universities and research institutions across the globe. The programme is designed to promote high-impact research, global academic integration, and collaborative supervision between DBS Global University and its international partners.

The Joint Doctoral Programme provides scholars with the opportunity to pursue advanced research under dual academic mentorship, enabling access to global research ecosystems, laboratories, industry networks, and interdisciplinary expertise.

Programme Structure

The Joint Doctoral Programme is structured to ensure academic rigor, international exposure, and research excellence. Key features include:

  • Joint Supervision Model Each doctoral scholar is guided by: One Research Supervisor from DBS Global University and One Co-Supervisor from the Partner International University
  • Research Framework The research proposal is jointly approved by both institutions, ensuring alignment with international research standards.
  • Mobility Component Scholars undertake a defined research residency at the partner university, subject to agreed timelines and academic requirements.
  • Shared Research Infrastructure Access to laboratories, libraries, databases, research centres, and innovation hubs at both institutions.
  • Joint Evaluation Process Thesis review, examination, and viva voce are conducted as per mutually agreed academic regulations of both universities.
Degree Award

A Jointly Awarded Doctoral Degree (single certificate carrying the names and insignia of both institutions),

OR

A Dual Doctoral Degree (separate PhD degrees awarded by each institution), as per the terms of the specific collaboration agreement.

Research Areas

The Joint Doctoral Programme is available across multidisciplinary domains including but not limited to

  • Engineering & Technology
  • Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence
  • Management & Business Studies
  • Law & Public Policy
  • Social Sciences & Humanities
  • Applied Sciences
  • Interdisciplinary & Emerging Technologies
Eligibility Criteria

The Joint Doctoral Programme is available across multidisciplinary domains including but not limited to

  • Master’s Degree in a relevant discipline with required academic standing
  • Demonstrated research aptitude
  • Fulfilment of admission criteria of both DBS Global University and the Partner University
  • Language proficiency as applicable
Duration
  • Minimum Duration: As per doctoral regulations of DBS Global University
  • Maximum Duration: As per joint agreement norms
  • Research residency period at partner institution: Defined within programme framework
Distinctive Advantages
  • Global research exposure
  • International academic networking
  • Co-authored publications in high-impact journals
  • Enhanced employability in global academia and industry
  • Access to cross-border funding and research grants
  • Opportunity to work on globally relevant research problems
Governance & Academic Quality

The Joint Doctoral Programme operates under

  • Approved Academic Regulations of DBS Global University
  • Bilateral Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with partner institutions
  • Joint Doctoral Oversight Committee for monitoring progress and quality assurance

Renowned faculty members guide students through a personalized and collaborative learning experience, promoting interdisciplinary approaches. DBS Global University's commitment to global perspectives ensures an inclusive and diverse academic environment. With state-of-the-art facilities and a dynamic research community, the doctoral program at DBS Global University prepares students for impactful contributions to academia, industry, and society, positioning them as influential leaders in their chosen fields.

Introduction

Admissions to Ph.D. programs at DBS Global University campus are held twice a year, for the January and July sessions. The Ph.D. program is available in two formats: Full-time and Part-time, with no distance learning option. Regular participation in coursework, various interactions, and submission of progress reports through presentations is mandatory.

A Full-time Ph.D. scholar dedicates his/her full time to the program requirements, while a Part-time Ph.D. scholar balances their research with employment responsibilities. The minimum duration for a Full-time Ph.D. is three years, and for a Part-time Ph.D., it is Four years. The maximum duration for both formats is six years.

Part-time candidates must ensure their workplace provides the necessary facilities and infrastructure conducive to research. Additionally, they are required to have a Co-guide from their organization, subject to approval by the university authorities.

DBS Global University promotes interdisciplinary research and the exchange of ideas across various fields. Scholars may appoint a Co-guide from outside DBS Global University in accordance with university rules and due approvals. The primary Guide for the scholar will be a DBS Global University faculty member, selected based on the research topic and availability. Full-time Ph.D. candidates also have the opportunity to work as research fellows on prestigious ongoing research projects at the university.

Abstract

Uttarakhand is endowed with an extraordinary wealth of forest and agro-biodiversity, yet many commercially and medicinally important species remain genetically under-characterized and conservation-neglected. The Centre of Excellence in Plant Genomics, Agroforestry Conservation & Sustainable Utilization of Biodiversity (CoE-PGACS) is proposed to address this critical knowledge and capacity gap through an integrated, multidisciplinary research programme.

The Centre will use molecular marker technologies — particularly Simple Sequence Repeats (SSRs) and other PCR-based tools — to assess genetic diversity, mating systems, and contemporary gene flow in priority plant species, beginning with Schleichera oleosa (Kusum). The research framework is deliberately designed to encompass both forest and agricultural species, embedding the agriculture angle from inception so that the Centre's scope can organically expand to include medicinal crops, wild crop relatives, multipurpose agroforestry species, and underutilized cultivated plants of the state.

Parallel to the molecular genomics track, the Centre will investigate the insect biota associated with priority plant species, including pest complexes affecting both forest and agricultural crops, thereby generating integrated pest management insights of direct relevance to farming communities. Field ecology, ethnobotanical surveys, and community engagement components will ground the scientific outputs in real-world conservation and livelihood contexts.

Over three years, CoE-PGACS will deliver a functional molecular biology laboratory, validated genomic datasets, mating system and gene flow data, insect diversity catalogues, community resource maps, rural livelihood linkages, doctoral research outputs, and peer-reviewed publications — forming the scientific and policy foundation for long-term genetic resource management, agroforestry planning, and conservation action in Uttarakhand. The Centre's institutional home within the Department of Agriculture & Forestry at DBS Global University ensures the science remains grounded in agricultural realities and rural development contexts.

Abstract

Indian enterprises, particularly MSMEs and emerging conglomerates, are increasingly confronted with high-velocity, complex decision environments where conventional management science tools fail to keep pace. Despite rapid advances in artificial intelligence, two critical gaps persist: (i) the managerial application of Agentic AI - autonomous goal-directed AI systems capable of multi-step business reasoning - remains almost entirely unresearched in management literature; and (ii) explainability of deep learning models in business contexts, from a governance and managerial accountability perspective rather than a purely technical viewpoint, is nascent and fragmented.

This project proposes a three-year interdisciplinary research programme that pioneers three interconnected streams: first, the architecture and empirical validation of Agentic AI Decision Support Systems (ADSS) for strategic management scenarios including scenario planning, competitive intelligence, and supply chain governance; second, the development of Explainable Deep Learning (XDL) models for financial risk scoring, fraud pattern detection, and business intelligence dashboards that satisfy both predictive accuracy and managerial interpretability standards; and third, AI-augmented models for marketing intelligence and human-AI collaborative HR systems that support organizational resilience measurement in disrupted environments.

The research will generate: two doctoral theses; a minimum of six peer-reviewed publications in ABDC/SCOPUS/SCI-indexed journals; at least two patent or copyright registrations; three enterprise-grade AI prototype tools; labelled Indian enterprise datasets; and validated governance frameworks for responsible agentic AI deployment in business settings.

This project uniquely positions CE-AIMB and DBS Global University at the frontier of management AI research - a space currently dominated by technology institutes, not business schools - thereby establishing genuine academic leadership in a high-impact, high-urgency domain.

Principal Investigator

Dr. Puneet Kumar

Abstract

The Garhwal region's Himalayan forest ecosystems are crucial to the environment, but because of their difficult terrain and restricted accessibility, they are challenging to monitor. Conservation of biodiversity, monitoring of forest health, disaster risk reduction, and sustainable environmental planning all depend on accurate landscape classification.

The goal of this project is to create an autonomous robotic system with AI capabilities that can acquire terrain-aware ecological data and classify intelligent landscapes. In order to categories vegetation types, forest density, degraded land zones, and ecological risk areas, the system will combine robotics, embedded sensing, computer vision, and deep learning techniques.

The Center for Robotics and Automation (CRA) will develop a robust robotic platform with multimodal sensors, such as RGB imaging, multispectral sensing, GPS, and inertial navigation systems. Field-acquired datasets gathered over several seasons will be used to train machine learning models.

A validated prototype (TRL-6/7), ecological datasets, peer-reviewed publications, doctoral research outputs, and patentable indigenous technologies supporting intelligent environmental monitoring in Himalayan ecosystems will all be produced over the course of the project's three-year duration.

label: Leadership Series
html:
At DBS, it is our belief that experiences of corporate leaders provide invaluable learning to the students of management. The Leadership Lecture Series has been designed to serve as a forum for exchange of intellectually stimulating ideas between business heads and future managers through the lecture format. Such sessions see students getting a practical perspective on the theoretical concepts learnt in class with the industry stalwarts gaining fresher and newer ideas. Continuing with this tradition, DBS saw the most successful managers, leaders, and thinkers descend on campus during the previous academic year.

Apart from Lecture Series, Workshops serve as customized avenues for organizations to interact with students. Simulation games, experiential exercises, and domain-specific training are some examples of the types of workshops that have been explored in the past.

Live Projects are an excellent opportunity for the students to assist managers in solving live business issues. These live projects could either be in the form of an independent project or a part of an ongoing project. For students, these projects are an opportunity to showcase their skills in the related areas in real business scenarios. For participating organizations, it is an opportunity to evaluate and leverage the calibre and intellectual capital of the students. At DBS, Live Projects are considered extremely serious assignments and hence each project is supervised by a faculty mentor who both guides the students doing the project and continually monitors the project’s progress. Our students have been appreciated in the past for their efforts in Live Projects at leading organizations such as ITC, Tata Motors, Uniqlo, Flipkart, Samsung.

html:

Early Admission Process (For students appearing for class XII and awaiting results)

Students upon registration are evaluated on the basis of their academic performance in class X, XI and their performance in the DBS Global University Entrance Examination and online interview. Those who score above the threshold aggregate in (X, XI, test & Interview) will be offered a seat subject to meeting the qualifying criteria of the university in Class XII (which will be mentioned in the Offer Letter).

Applicable till 1st June, 2026 or XII result declaration whichever is early.

In case a student applies for early decision and is unable to cross the required threshold he/she will be considered for regular decision subsequently. Students should send their class XII marks mentioning their DBS Application no. on [email protected] within 15 days of receiving the board results.

Regular Admission Process (After declaration of XII result):

Admission to the BBA program is on the merit of Academic records and Online Interview.

  • Applicants appearing in their class 12 examinations through any of the Boards affiliated to the Council of Boards of School Education should have a minimum 80% average marks in 04 core subjects or CUET (UG) Percentile 60 and above will be exempted from online interviews.
  • Applicants whose average marks is less than 80% in 04 core subjects or CUET (UG) Percentile below 60 will need to appear for an online interview for the screening.

Admission to the B.Com program is on the merit of Academic records and Online Interview.

  • Applicants appearing in their class 12 examinations through any of the Boards affiliated to the Council of Boards of School Education should have a minimum 75% average marks in 04 core subjects or CUET (UG) Percentile 60 and above will be exempted from online interviews.
  • Applicants whose average marks is less than 75% in 04 core subjects or CUET (UG) Percentile below 60 will need to appear for an online interview for the screening.
For MBA Program
  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline, with a percentage of 50% or more/an equivalent grade. Final-year undergraduate students can apply. For Business Analytics and Digital Transformation, applicants with BTech/BCA/MCA/BSc/BSc (Economics) or any other degree from a recognized institution with computer science/mathematics/statistics as one of the electives will be preferred.
  • The applicant is required to have a score of one of the following entrance examinations: CAT/ NMAT/ GMAT/ CMAT/ XAT/GRE or DBS Global University Entrance Examination.
  • Admissions in the MBA programs are on the basis of merit of MAT/CAT /CMAT/ XAT/GMAT or DBS Global University Entrance Examination scores, 10th, 12th & graduation marks and online interview of the shortlisted candidates. The basis of weightage as under:
  • Class XII & Graduation % - 30%
  • MAT/CAT /CMAT/ XAT/GMAT or DBS Global University Entrance Examination (Normalised internally) - 40%
  • Online Interview - 30%
 

Note: DBS Global University Entrance Examination is an online writing test which is conducted at the time of online interview.

Regular Admission Process (After declaration of XII result):

Admission to the B.Tech program is on the merit of Academic records and Online Interview.

Direct Admissions - Applicants appearing in their class 12 examinations through any of the Boards affiliated to the Council of Boards of School Education should have a minimum 85% average marks in 04 Subjects i.e Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and 01 Core Subject or JEE Percentile 50 with minimum 50% average marks in 04 Subjects i.e Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and 01 Core Subject and above will be exempted from online interviews.

Applicants whose average marks is less than 85% in 4 Subjects i.e Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and 01 Core Subject or JEE percentile below 50 will need to appear for DBS Global University (DGU AT- Online Test ) for the screening.

Specialization / Courses shall be offered on the basis of first come first basis of date of submission of admission fees. In case of delay beyond the stipulated date the student will be put on a rolling admission category and seat/ specialization will be confirmed next in waiting.

Confirmation to the rolling seat will be subject to availability of seat and pipeline of current admission offers on the date of receipt of conditional admission fees.

Note for UG program:

A merit list would be drawn up based on the number of students opting for the program and a cutoff would be developed based on the number of seats. Only those students who make it to the merit list, based on class XII result & interview scores, of a particular course, may be offered a seat in the program. As the seats are limited, the university reserves the right to offer the seat to the next eligible candidate, in case the student fails to reserve his/her seat.

For M.Tech

Bachelor’s degree in B.Tech CSE , with a percentage of 60% or more / an equivalent grade. Final-year undergraduate students can apply. Applicants need to appear for the GATE / CUET (PG) or DBS Global University Entrance Examination and online interview.

MCA

Candidates must have completed 10+2+3-year bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Computer Applications/IT or an equivalent degree from a university/institution as recognized by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) or other competent bodies.

Or Candidates who have completed 10+2+3-year bachelor’s degree in any other discipline must have studied mathematics in bachelor’s or 10+2. Such candidates need to complete the additional bridge courses as per the norms of the university.

Eligibility and Admission Process:

DIRECT ADMISSION TO FULL TIME B.TECH. PROGRAMME THROUGH LATERAL ENTRY (2nd Year)

Admissions in second year (3rd semester) of B.Tech. Programmes in Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)

  • Eligibility

    The candidates should have passed:-

    Passed Minimum three years / two years (Lateral Entry) Diploma examination with at least 45% marks (40% marks in case of candidates belonging to reserved category) in ANY branch of Engineering and Technology.

    OR

    Passed B.Sc. Degree from a recognized University as defined by UGC, with at least 45% marks (40% marks in case of candidates belonging to reserved category) and passed 10+2 examination with Mathematics as a subject.

    Candidates likely to pass the above said qualifying examinations by July/Aug 2024 are also eligible to apply. However, they must produce the qualifying certificates before 30th September 2026 for regularizing admissions.

  • Selection Process

    The admission will be purely on merit of online interview, determined by:-

    • Marks obtained in relevant examination as per eligibility criterion.
    • Candidates are required to visit the university website www.dgu.ac regularly for updates.
  • Bridge Courses

label: Scholarships
html:
At DBS Global University, we believe that quality education should be accessible to every deserving student. Our scholarship policy has been designed with a strong commitment towards merit, inclusion, and financial support, making it one of the most distinctive and student-friendly scholarship frameworks in higher education.

The University offers a wide range of scholarships for meritorious students, Uttarakhand domicile students, wards of Defence personnel, teachers, and single-mother girl children. These scholarships are applicable for the complete duration of the program, ensuring long-term academic support and financial stability for students and families.

Students who are academically deserving or financially in need are also encouraged to apply for the ESKAY Educational Trust Scholarship, created to support bright students in achieving their educational aspirations without financial barriers.

Over the last two years, DBS Global University has awarded scholarships to more than 1,200 students, with an overall scholarship support exceeding ₹7 Crores, reflecting the University’s commitment to empowering future leaders through accessible education.

Satya Scholarship, the University has introduced a Special Scholarship for students from Bihar(not applicable for programs under Doon Business School). Students eligible under the Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme can avail scholarship support of up to 25% of the academic fee or ₹2.5 Lakhs, whichever is lower, for the complete duration of the program.

At DBS Global University, scholarships are not just financial assistance; they are a commitment to nurturing talent, encouraging diversity, and transforming lives through education.

  • Students shall take a good moral character certificate from the Course Coordinator every year and submit the same with the Registrar along with the renewal of scholarship for that semester/year. label: Hostel Life
html:
Top reasons to live on campus

Choosing to live on campus can ease the transition to college life. Living on campus means you will be more plugged-in to the campus community and have more opportunities to join clubs, attend campus events, meet new people and develop friendships.
Living on campus provides students with a unique living experience. Here are our Top Ten reasons to live on campus!
  • Live Smart. Research shows that students who live on campus have higher CGPAs.
  • Live Close. Roll out of bed and get to class in 5 minutes! You are right next to the library, dining halls & other academic blocks.
  • Live Wireless. Students who live on campus have access to computer labs and high- speed wireless connectivity.
  • Live Secure. Doon Business School Group makes the safety of its residents a top priority.
  • Live in a Community. Students who live on campus interact with students from other states and countries. Friendships formed during college last a lifetime.
  • Leadership opportunities. By living on campus, students are more likely to get involved in student organizations, leadership skills that look great on a resume.
  • Live Cheaper. The cost of living on campus is less than living off campus. Campus housing includes not only the cost of your room, high speed internet and 24-hour security.
  • Live Connected. Campus residents have a stronger connection to the campus community. Because they are living in the center of all the action.
  • Live Fun! Living in the residence halls is a fun experience. Social and educational activities are available for residents to enjoy.
  • Live DBS! Experience the complete package of college life at DBS by showing your Herd pride. Make memories and friendships that will last a lifetime.

label: College Fest
html:
Doon Business School, a prominent management institute in Uttarakhand, organized MANFEST-2023, the largest annual management event in the North region. This highly anticipated business extravaganza centered on the theme of Artificial Intelligence, a topic of significant interest and importance, aimed at fostering students' robust foundation and advancement. The event began with Brand Aid, an initiative spearheaded by the students themselves. They established their own brands and competed against each other to exhibit their best offerings.

The Founding member Mr. Mohit Aggarwal of Doon Business School Group and First Trustee Dr. Anjum Aggarwal of S.K. Educational Trust, along with the Honorable Additional Director General of Police Mr. Amit Sinha, presented awards to the victors of the diverse competitions held during MANFEST-2023, motivating the students to strive for greater achievements. The festival attracted participants from approximately 36 colleges across India who competed in numerous activities, such as Devil's Advocate, Corporate Roadies, HR Role Play, Graffiti, Bizquiz, JAM, Investrix, Case Study, Shipwreck, HR Fest, Photography, Dumb Charades, Dance, Singing, War of Bands, among others. The aim of the event was not centered on winning or losing, but rather on participation and maintaining motivation throughout. Aside from Doon Business School, other colleges, including Himgiri Zee University and NIMBUS Institute, participated in the event.

Manfest Day 1
Manfest Day 2
Manfest Day 3

This was a 3 days event & it started with Brand Aid on 13th of April, 2023 all the management competitions were conducted in the first half and the day ended with Solo-Singing and Solo-Dancing events. On the 14th of April, 2023, After a fierce battle among the talented participants, we have our winners! The team that emerged victorious and claimed the prestigious Brand Aid title has secured a remarkable prize of 60 thousand rupees. Their innovative approach and outstanding execution set them apart, impressing both the judges and the audience.Doon Business School also organized an electrifying DJ Night as part of the MANFEST-2023. The event began with an opening set by Aks Music. The DJ Night event at Doon Business School was held on the 14th of April, 2023, on the college ground which was transformed into a club-like atmosphere with dim lighting and colorful disco lights. A vocal mix of Bollywood and Punjabi tracks by Aks Music marked the opening set and got the crowd going, with everyone dancing and grooving to the beats.

Manfest Day 4
Manfest Day 5

The main act of the night, DJ Zuby, a renowned DJ who has performed at some of the biggest clubs and festivals in the country, took over the console and played a perfect blend of EDM, techno, and house music, which kept the crowd on their feet for hours. The event was a tremendous success, and the ambiance was perfect for the occasion, with the sound system being top-notch. The DJ Night was a great opportunity for the students to unwind and let loose after a hectic semester, and it will be remembered by everyone who attended. We look forward to organizing more such events in the future. On the evening of April 15th, the final day of MANFEST-2023, Doon Business School was filled with excitement and anticipation as students and fans of Bollywood music gathered for the highly-anticipated concert of popular Bollywood playback singer, Khushboo Grewal.

The event commenced at 7 pm as Miss Grewal took to the stage amidst cheers and applause from the crowd, creating an electric atmosphere. The event will undoubtedly be remembered as a memorable night of entertainment and celebration, with the audience wanting more. The concert was a resounding success, bringing together students and music lovers to celebrate the power of music. It was a testament to the commitment of Doon Business School towards creating an environment that fosters creativity, innovation, and talent.

html:
Introduction

The DBS Global University Badminton Club is a vibrant, student-driven platform for individuals passionate about badminton, fitness, and competitive sports. The club aims to promote a culture of physical well-being, discipline, and sportsmanship while providing students with opportunities to enhance their skills both recreationally and competitively.

It serves as a dynamic space where students can learn, practice, and excel in badminton through regular training sessions, friendly matches, and inter-college competitions. The club encourages participation at all skill levels—from beginners to advanced players—fostering inclusivity and teamwork.

Through activities such as tournaments, skill-development workshops, coaching sessions, and sports events, the club seeks to nurture talent, build confidence, and instill leadership qualities among students. It also promotes a healthy balance between academics and physical activity, contributing to the overall personality development of students.

The DBS Global University Badminton Club stands as a platform where passion meets performance, and students grow through sport, collaboration, and healthy competition.

What Students Can Gain

The Badminton Club aims to develop athletic skills, teamwork, and discipline among students by:

  • Physical Fitness and Skill Development: Enhances agility, endurance, and overall fitness while improving technical and tactical badminton skills.
  • Confidence and Mental Strength: Regular practice and competitions build confidence, focus, and mental resilience.
  • Development of Life Skills: Promotes teamwork, discipline, time management, and sportsmanship.
  • Competitive Exposure: Provides opportunities to participate in tournaments, workshops, and matches with skilled players.
  • Holistic Personality Development: Supports stress management and helps maintain a balance between academics and co-curricular activities.
  • Access to Qualified Coaches: Offers guidance from experienced coaches for continuous skill enhancement.
  • Structured Coaching Sessions: Includes training on basic techniques, advanced strategies, fitness, and match preparation.
  • Personalized Feedback and Improvement: Regular interaction with coaches helps identify strengths and areas for improvement.
  • Workshops and Performance Assessments: Conducts special training sessions and evaluations to ensure continuous progress.
  • Inclusive Learning Environment: Caters to all skill levels, from beginners to advanced players.
  • Competitive Mindset Development: Builds confidence and prepares students for higher-level competitions.

Achievements

The Badminton Club has consistently demonstrated excellence through active participation and commendable performance in various inter-university tournaments, invitational championships, and institutional sports events.

  • Active participation of club members in various inter-university badminton tournaments
  • Reached the National Semifinal- NISM National Financial Literacy Quiz in 2024
  • Representation of the university at zonal, state-level, and national-level university competitions

  • Enhanced visibility of the university through consistent presence in competitive sports events
  • Development of leadership, teamwork, discipline, and competitive spirit among students
  • Promotion of a strong sports culture and student engagement on campus Regular organization of intra-university tournaments, selection trials, and practice sessions
  • Strengthening of university branding through sports achievements and student excellence

The following rules and regulations shall govern the functioning of the Badminton Club to ensure discipline, professionalism, and smooth conduct of all activities:

  • 1. Membership: Membership is open to all interested students of the university. Students must register officially with the club coordinator. Members are expected to participate actively in practice sessions, meetings, and tournaments. Regular attendance is mandatory to remain an active club member.
  • 2. Discipline and Conduct - All members must maintain discipline, punctuality, and sportsman spirit. Respect toward coaches, faculty coordinators, officials, and fellow players is mandatory. Any misconduct, abusive behavior, or violation of university norms may lead to suspension from the club. Members must use university sports facilities responsibly.
  • 3. Practice Sessions - Members must report on time for all practice sessions. Proper sports attire and non-marking shoes are compulsory. Absence from practice should be informed in advance to the club coordinator. Members should follow the training schedule and instructions of the coach.
  • 4. Tournament Participation - Selection for tournaments shall be based on performance, discipline, and regular attendance. Selected players must represent the university with full commitment. Team decisions made by the coach/selection committee shall be final. Participants must adhere to tournament rules and code of conduct.
  • 5. Equipment Usage - Club equipment such as rackets, shuttlecocks, nets, and court accessories must be handled carefully. Any damage or loss of equipment due to negligence may be recovered from the concerned student. Equipment must be returned after use in proper condition.
  • 6. Event Management - Members may be assigned duties during tournaments, trials, and club events. Active support in organizing university sports events is expected from all members. Members should contribute to promoting sports culture within the campus.
  • 7. Code of Sportsmanship - Fair play, honesty, and respect for opponents must be maintained at all times. Decisions of referees and match officials must be accepted gracefully. Unsportsmanlike conduct may result in disciplinary action.
  • 8. General - The club coordinator reserves the right to amend rules as required. All matters not covered under these rules shall be decided by the faculty coordinator and university sports committee. Members must comply with all university policies in addition to club rules.

label: 8 Ball Pool Club
html:
Introduction

The 8 Ball Pool Club at DBS Global University is a vibrant community of cue sports enthusiasts who share a passion for precision, strategy, and competitive spirit. As part of the university’s diverse student club ecosystem, the club provides a platform for students to engage in recreational and competitive pool, fostering both skill development and camaraderie.

Built on the principles of focus, discipline, and sportsmanship, the club encourages players of all levels—from beginners to advanced competitors to participate, learn, and grow. Regular practice sessions, friendly matches, and intra-club tournaments are organized to sharpen techniques and build confidence under pressure.

With access to well-equipped recreational facilities and a campus culture that promotes indoor sports like snooker and table games, members enjoy a structured yet relaxed environment to pursue the game.

Beyond the table, the club emphasizes strategic thinking, patience, and mental resilience qualities that extend far beyond the game into academics and professional life. Whether you’re here to compete, unwind, or master the art of cue control, the 8 Ball Pool Club offers a space where passion meets precision.

What Students Can Gain

  • Practical Skill & Game Mastery: Hands-on improvement in cue control, shot accuracy, positioning, and match strategy through regular play and peer learning.
  • Competitive Exposure: Opportunities to participate in structured tournaments and leagues, building confidence and performance under pressure.
  • Strategic Thinking Ability: Sharper decision-making, planning, and anticipation skills developed through tactical gameplay.
  • Discipline & Focus: Enhanced concentration, patience, and composure—qualities that carry over into academics and professional life.
  • Networking & Camaraderie: A strong peer group with shared interests, fostering friendships, collaboration, and a sense of belonging on campus.
  • Stress Relief & Recreation: A productive break from academic rigor, helping maintain mental balance and overall well-being.

Achievements

  • Regular Practice Sessions: Scheduled weekly sessions for members to play, improve techniques, and learn positioning, cue control, and shot selection
  • Intra-Club Tournaments & Leagues: Monthly tournaments and seasonal leagues to build competitive spirit and track player performance over time
  • Skill Development Workshops: Focused sessions on advanced gameplay—break strategies, defensive shots, angle play, and match tactics
  • Friendly Matches & Challenges: Casual yet competitive matches among members to encourage participation and continuous engagement
  • Inter-College Competitions: Representation of the university in external tournaments to gain exposure and build a competitive reputation
  • Mentorship & Peer Learning: Experienced players guiding beginners, creating a culture of learning and continuous improvement
  • Event Hosting & Campus Engagement: Organizing open pool events, mini-challenges, and game nights to attract new members and promote the club

Introduction

The Music Club of DBS Global University participated in the prestigious Battle of Bands competition at Amity Youth Fest 2026, one of North India's largest inter-college cultural festivals. Battle of Bands is a highly competitive musical event that brings together talented bands from universities across the region to showcase their musical prowess, stage presence, and original compositions. What Students Can Gain

  • Social and emotional benefits: Music clubs create a strong sense of community where members make friends who share similar interests and passions. Regular rehearsals and performances reduce stress, improve mood, and increase self?esteem and emotional expression.

label: Bagpackers Club
html:
Introduction

The Bagpackers' Club is a student and faculty-driven community at DBS Global University that brings together like-minded adventurers passionate about trekking, camping, and exploring the great outdoors.

The club aims to provide opportunities to explore various cultures and the picturesque Himalayas of Uttarakhand and Himachal. In today's world of chaos and constant stimulation, it's hard to quiet the mind and think. Getting into nature offers a way to find some silence and clarity, an important tool to counter the pressures of modern life.

The more pressure we put on ourselves, the more our health degrades. The Bagpackers' Club exists to remind students that the mountains are always calling, and the trail is the best classroom.

What Students Can Gain

Members of the Bagpackers' Club gain far more than just travel memories. They benefit in the following ways:

  • Improved physical fitness and mental well-being through regular outdoor activities and treks.
  • Enhanced teamwork, communication, and leadership skills developed in challenging terrain.
  • First-hand exposure to the rich cultural traditions, local communities, and biodiversity of the Himalayan belt.
  • Stress relief and mental clarity, nature serves as therapy against the pressures of academic and everyday life.
  • Development of survival skills, navigation, and self-reliance in outdoor settings.
  • A strong peer network of adventure enthusiasts and like-minded explorers.
  • Confidence and resilience built through overcoming physical challenges on the trail.
  • Appreciation for environmental conservation and sustainable travel practices.

label: Fit Don't Quit Club
html:
Introduction

The FDQ (Fit Don’t Quit) Club is a student-led fitness community dedicated to promoting health, discipline, and consistency as essential aspects of everyday life. The club serves as a platform where students actively engage in structured fitness challenges, competitions, and awareness initiatives.

FDQ believes that fitness is not just about physical strength, but also about mental resilience and self-discipline. Through an inclusive and motivating environment, the club encourages individuals to push beyond their limits, adopt healthier lifestyles, and build long-term habits that extend beyond college life.

What Students Can Gain

Being a part of the FDQ (Fit Don’t Quit) Club offers much more than just fitness—it delivers a complete personal development experience :

  • Physical Fitness & Health: Members improve their overall fitness through structured challenges, regular activities, and active participation, leading to better strength, stamina, and well-being.
  • Mental Strength & Resilience: Through challenges and competitions, members develop a strong mindset, learning how to push limits, overcome setbacks, and stay focused.
  • Competitive Spirit: Fitness challenges create a healthy competitive environment where members strive to perform better and achieve their personal best.
  • Confidence & Self-Growth: Achieving fitness milestones boosts self-confidence and encourages personal growth both physically and mentally.
  • Community & Networking: Members become part of a supportive and motivating community, building friendships and connections with like-minded individuals.
  • Leadership & Teamwork Opportunities: Active members can take up leadership roles, manage events, and develop teamwork, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Recognition & Achievements: Top performers and consistent participants receive recognition, certificates, and appreciation, adding value to their personal and professional profiles.

Achievements

The FDQ (Fit Don’t Quit) Club conducts a variety of engaging and result-driven activities designed to promote fitness, consistency, and community participation :

  • Fitness Challenges: Regularly organized challenges such as 30-day fitness transformations, step-count competitions, push-up/squat challenges, and endurance tasks that encourage consistency and measurable progress.
  • Workout Sessions & Bootcamps: Group workout sessions, including cardio, strength training, functional fitness, and outdoor bootcamps, designed to improve overall fitness levels in a fun and energetic environment.
  • Competitions & Events: Inter-college and intra-college fitness competitions that build a competitive spirit, allowing participants to test their strength, stamina, and discipline.
  • Health & Awareness Campaigns: Initiatives focused on spreading awareness about fitness, nutrition, mental well-being, and healthy lifestyle habits through seminars, campaigns, and interactive sessions.
  • Transformation & Progress Tracking: Members track their fitness journey through before-after transformations, progress logs, and performance metrics, helping them stay accountable and motivated.
  • Collaborations & Workshops: Partnerships with fitness trainers, gyms, and wellness experts to conduct workshops on nutrition, workout techniques, injury prevention, and lifestyle management.
  • Community Engagement Activities: Group runs, fitness marathons, and outdoor activities that strengthen the sense of community, teamwork, and motivation among members.

label: Dehradun Advantage
html:
Studying at Dehradun

Surrounded by misty hills, lush green valleys, and crisp mountain air, DBS Global University stands in a setting that feels both peaceful and inspiring. Studying in Dehradun means learning within a breathtaking landscape while enjoying modern infrastructure and advanced facilities that prepare you confidently for the demands of today’s industry.

Amazing Dehradun

Imagine a student life away from the constant rush of crowded cities. A place where fresh mountain air, lush greenery, and quiet surroundings create the right space to think, learn, and grow. Free from traffic chaos and daily noise, students can focus their time and energy on what truly matters. It is no surprise that an environment like this shapes confident and capable professionals across industries.

The Himalayas stand tall around Dehradun, giving the city a calm and reassuring presence. Natural beauty is not just a backdrop here. It becomes part of everyday life. The peaceful surroundings help students stay balanced even during demanding academic schedules. There is a reason why Dehradun and nearby Mussoorie are known as education hubs. The setting supports concentration, reflection, and personal growth.

It has often been observed that students perform better in healthy and focused environments. When parents consider sending their children abroad, it is rarely about distance alone. It is about exposure, quality infrastructure, and the ability to concentrate without distractions. They want their children to work with advanced technology, learn from experienced mentors, and be fully prepared for the real world.

DBS Global University brings these advantages together in one place. The campus offers modern infrastructure built to international standards, along with a strong academic team that includes graduates from institutions such as FMS and IIM. Students receive global exposure while staying connected to the comfort and familiarity of home. When the environment, facilities, and guidance align so well, the choice becomes clear.

Forest Research Institute

The premier research institute of forestry in India is located in Dehradun. The Forest Research Institute was established in 1906 as the British Imperial Forestry Service. The site also contains a museum for forestry with six main sections that are Pathology Museum, Social Forestry Museum, Silviculture Museum, Timber Museum, Non-Wood Forest Products Museum and Entomology Museum.

Set amidst the lush green of the beautiful town of Dehradun, Forest Research Institute is an education and tourist spot. It is known for its natural diversity, spectacular beauty and magnificent architecture, this institute is one of the top places to see in Dehradun. The institute offers education and research in different areas of forestry - plants, climate, topography, animals, and birds of the Himalayan forests.

Sahastradhara

The word Sahastradhara means 'Thousand fold spring', The beauty of this waterfall during the rainy season is spellbinding. The magnificent waterfall and the alluring atmosphere make this place a perfect getaway. Spend some quality time with your peeps here and share some joyous moments

The area has got an amazing spread of waterfalls and caves which are a treat to the eye. The water which drips off the stalactites has got a good amount of Sulphur in it due to its limestone content.

This Sulphur is what is believed to make the water medicinal with a lot of people visiting the spot for its healing properties. With an amusement park and also a ropeway for visitors to spend their time in, Sahastradhara is the perfect tourist destination for friends and family alike.

label: Law Activities
html:
Moot Court & Legal Aid Cell

Moot Court Cell

If good lawyering skills are essential for an advocate, mooting during law school is the greatest asset that a student can inculcate. Here, at Doon School of Law, we understand this need to encourage mooting and aspire to create such a healthy pool of young lawyers. The Moot Court Cell is the institution's student committee entrusted with fostering, administering and facilitating mooting activities and upholding the benchmark of excellence that Doon School of Law has set for itself.

Moot Court Cell serves to develop future mooters, as well as an interest in mooting. In pursuance of this, the Doon School of Law follows a policy of encouraging participation in mooting from all batches, including the first years. To allow them to compete on an equal footing, the Doon School of Law organizes extensive workshops and demonstrations to enable them to learn the process of mooting from the very basics to the most intricate details. Further, the Doon School of Law arranges for interactive sessions with experienced mooters and litigators from previous batches to guide the present mooters in a better manner.

Students who represent the college in the national and international mooting circuit are trained and assisted by not only the Moot Court Cell members, but also by experts in the various fields of law. Workshops are conducted regularly to hone the oratory and presentation skills of the students. Memorials are reviewed and mock pleadings are conducted by both faculty and senior mooters to ensure that every team which represents the college has been given optimum training.

Legal Aid Cell

The Legal Aid Cell at DBS Global University is a dedicated initiative committed to promoting access to justice and fostering a sense of social responsibility among students.

Operating as a bridge between the legal community and society, the cell provides free legal assistance to underprivileged and marginalized individuals who may not otherwise have access to legal resources. Under the guidance of experienced faculty and practising lawyers, students actively engage in drafting legal documents, offering consultations, and conducting awareness programs on rights and legal remedies.

The Legal Aid Cell also organizes workshops, legal literacy camps, and pro-bono projects, empowering communities while providing students with hands-on experience in addressing real-world legal challenges. This initiative reflects the university's commitment to ethical practice and social equity, shaping students into empathetic and responsible legal professionals.

Central Library

DBS Global University has a well stocked library and a rich repository of journals and periodicals for the benefit of students and faculty. This is one facility that sees regular additions.

E-Library

DGU is digitizing content for all the courses so that students can refer to the main content as well as reference books at their convenience from anywhere. DGU is planning to use the latest multimedia and IP multicast technology and software to provide a robust backbone to the e-library.

The DGU Library System comprises a Central Library and 1 departmental library that collectively support the teaching, research and extension programmes of the university.

Central-Library is a very special place in the DGU Campus with its rich collection of books and journals in the field of Management, Science, Technology and other related areas. The efficiency and effectiveness of our electronic resources and our professional services. Library stands as a unique Knowledge Centre that offers access to essential and specialized information resources and services to meet the growing information needs. LLibrary currently houses over 25000 Volumes of books and 20000 e-books. The Library Subscribes 15 numbers of National and International Journals and magazines. Library provides access to e-journals databases like EBSCO and DELNET etc. Oher resources include Videos, Audios, CDs, DVD, Question Papers, Thesis and Project Reports. Being fully computerised with 3M Security, it provides seamless access to many user oriented services and e- resources round the clock.

Our mission is to enhance and enable discovery through the effective utilization of information resources.

Medical Facilities & Tie ups

Health and Medical Facilities: Prioritizing Student Well-being

At DBS Global University, the health and safety of our students are paramount. We have partnered with some of Dehradun’s leading hospitals to ensure that students have access to reliable medical facilities during emergencies.

To make medical care seamless and stress-free, each student, upon admission, can avail of a Cashless Mediclaim Card (on a payment basis). This card provides cashless treatment options at the following top-tier hospitals in Dehradun

  • Max Super Speciality Hospital
  • Shri Guru Ram Rai Hospital
  • Synergy Hospital

On-Campus and Nearby First-Aid Facilities

For minor emergencies or first-aid requirements

  • Primary first-aid is readily available on campus and in the hostels.
  • The nearby Selaqui Health Center (SHC) is located just 500 meters from our campus for quick medical assistance.
  • Emergency Ambulance Services

Uttarakhand offers an efficient, free-of-cost 108 Ambulance Service that operates 24/7. Students can avail of this service for transportation to hospitals during emergencies.

Students can walk into any of these hospitals during a medical emergency and receive treatment without worrying about upfront payments.

Important Guidelines

While we provide access to essential medical resources, the institute cannot take complete medical responsibility for students. Therefore, we advise

  • Parents and students to ensure they have a local guardian in Dehradun for personal care and support during emergencies.
  • Outstation students to stay in regular touch with their families and guardians to ensure timely assistance when required.

At DBS Global University, we strive to create a safe and supportive environment for our students while encouraging a proactive approach to health and well-being. For any questions or support, feel free to contact our administrative team.

label: Career Outcomes at DGU
html:
“At DBS Global University, we recognize that success is personal. While some students aspire to build impactful careers, others seek admission to leading universities worldwide or dream of creating ventures of their own. To support these diverse ambitions, every student undergoes a Career Aspiration Survey during the penultimate year. Based on their goals, students are guided into one of three dedicated mentorship pathways- Career Placements, Higher Education, or Entrepreneurship. Each pathway is supported by specialized teams, industry mentors, and carefully curated interventions that provide personalized guidance and continuous handholding. Whether the destination is a leading organization, a globally reputed university, or a successful startup, our ecosystem is designed to transform aspirations into outcomes.”

Career Development & Placements - DBS Global University

Where preparation meets opportunity — and students meet their careers. At DGU, placements are not a one-time event. They are the result of months of structured preparation, continuous mentoring, and real industry exposure. With over 350 companies visiting campus every year — from India's most trusted conglomerates to leading tech and consulting firms — our students don't just get hired. They get hired right, into roles they are genuinely ready for.

Students go through multiple hiring simulations before facing actual recruiters — mock GDs, panel interviews, CV workshops, and direct sessions with industry leaders. Every round brings correction, feedback, and growth.

Personalised, not generic

The Career Development Cell works with each student individually, building on their strengths and preparing them for the roles they are targeting — not a generic placement process, but a personalised one.

Trusted by India's leading names

Recruiters span IT, BFSI, FMCG, Consulting, Manufacturing, Logistics, EdTech, Retail, Insurance, and E-commerce — offering students the flexibility to apply, explore, and secure the right fit.

Beyond the classroom

Don't just find a job.
Build one.

At DBS Global University, students turn bold ideas into running companies — backed by the DBX Incubator, a network of mentors, and a campus that celebrates the founder's journey.

Meet our founders How we support you
Founders we've backed are building in
 

The entrepreneurial path

Startup & Entrepreneurial Success

Some students graduate ready for a great career. Others graduate having already started one of their own. At DBS Global University, entrepreneurship isn't an afterthought — it's a path we actively build, from the first spark of an idea to a registered, working company.

Through the DBX Incubator, the student-led Innoventures Entrepreneurship Club, and our annual Entrepreneurial Conclave, founders get dedicated space, real mentorship, and direct access to industry. Design-thinking workshops, hackathons, and pitch nights turn classroom learning into market-ready ventures.

The result is a growing community of student and alumni founders building across technology, retail, agriculture, media, and social impact — and creating opportunities of their own.

Bold Ideas◆Real Ventures◆Lasting Impact

Beyond the classroom

Career Success in Higher Education

At DBS Global University, the journey to a leading university begins well before the application process. Through structured profile-building support, research exposure, internships, leadership opportunities, and a vibrant ecosystem of clubs and co-curricular activities, our students graduate with experiences that leading institutions value.

A distinctive part of the DBS experience is our annual social internship, where students engage with NGOs and community organisations — aligning their growth with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and developing a strong sense of social responsibility.

To support global aspirations, we provide guidance for examinations such as the GRE, GMAT, IELTS, and TOEFL, along with communication and language development initiatives for students aspiring to universities in India and abroad.

By combining academic excellence with holistic development, industry exposure, and experiential learning, DBS Global University equips students with the confidence and capabilities to pursue higher education opportunities at reputed institutions across the world.

label: Ombudsperson
html:
The Ombudsperson will make recommendations to students, faculty, staff and the University leadership on matters that are referenced to his office. The Ombudsperson will also counsel the complainants on avenues within and outside the University for redressal of their issues. As an external person with no conflict of interest, the Ombudsperson will provide counsel and guidance to DBS Global University community members on a confidential basis.

Any member of the DBS Global University community can reach out to the Ombudsperson for any issue they believe is not being satisfactorily resolved through the University’s existing processes.

The primary role of the Ombudsperson will be to ensure student, faculty and staff well-being, to provide a confidential and safe space for them to be heard, and to provide a forum should there be concerns in the realm of harassment, inappropriate behaviour, unprofessional conduct, abuse of power, unlawful termination of service or restrictions on university policy on freedom of expression and to advise both the students/faculty/staff member and the university on the resolution of disputes regarding the same.

  • Introduction
  • Functions
  • Vision & Mission
  • Governance

Introduction

The Office of Quality Initiatives and IQAC provide a robust framework for continually enhancing the quality of teaching, learning, and assessment. Rooted in the university’s commitment to academic excellence and innovation, this framework enables every academic unit to critically examine and strengthen its practices in alignment with global standards.

The office is entrusted with developing and implementing comprehensive quality benchmarks, internal academic audits, and structured feedback mechanisms. It also facilitates the university’s engagement with external assessments and accreditations. These efforts ensure that continuous quality enhancement remains integral to our institutional ethos.

To further reinforce this vision, the university has constituted the Internal Quality Assurance Committee (IQAC), which actively considers recommendations from diverse stakeholders—including faculty, students, alumni, and industry partners—to inform quality assurance strategies and decisions.

The Quality Office collaborates closely with the vice chancellor, registrar, and school deans to institutionalize a culture of excellence, transparency, and accountability. Through a clearly defined organizational structure and committee system, it ensures the strategic alignment of quality initiatives across all academic and administrative domains while recognizing and rewarding contributions from faculty and students alike.

At DBS Global University, quality assurance is not a one-time process but a sustained commitment to excellence. It supports compliance with national regulatory frameworks such as the Uttarakhand Private Universities (Amendment) Act, 2024, and with the guidelines of statutory bodies including the University Grants Commission (UGC), Bar Council of India (BCI), Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), and others. These regulatory imperatives are mapped to the university’s own vision and mission, shaping its core functions across teaching, research, innovation, and community engagement.

The university’s approach to assuring and enhancing academic quality is rooted in the following principles:

  • Alignment with the university’s vision and mission.
  • Development of systems that create a rich, inclusive, and participatory learning environment.
  • Empowerment of faculties and departments to take ownership of their quality assurance practices.
  • Promotion of collegiality, teamwork, and respect for diversity.
  • Continuous enhancement of the academic and institutional ecosystem.
  • Transparency and accountability to all internal and external stakeholders.

Key Functions of IQAC

The IQAC is responsible for channelizing and organizing the efforts of the institution towards quality enhancement. It ensures that clarity and focus is maintained in all quality-related activities. The main functions of the IQAC are listed below:

  • Development and application of quality benchmarks for academic and administrative activities
  • Creating a student-focused environment for quality education and faculty development
  • Collecting feedback from students, parents, and other stakeholders on quality-related processes
  • Sharing information on various quality parameters in higher education
  • Organizing workshops and seminars on quality-related themes
  • Keeping records of programmes and activities that lead to quality improvement
  • Developing a culture of quality in the institution
  • Preparing and submitting the Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR) to NAAC

Vision

To be a nationally recognized centre of institutional quality, building a culture of continuous improvement, evidence-based decision-making, and student-focused excellence — positioning DBS Global University among India's top-ranked institutions.

The vision is aligned with NEP 2020, the NAAC Accreditation Framework, and UGC Quality guidelines, and covers the following areas:

  • Academic excellence through careful curriculum design and outcome-based teaching
  • Institutional accountability through transparent documentation and data-based governance
  • Competitiveness by comparing ourselves with top-ranked institutions nationally and globally
  • Stakeholder trust through consistent quality assurance and public disclosure

Mission

The mission of the Office of Quality Initiatives is built on three core commitments:

  • To adopt and implement global best practices across academic and administrative functions of the University
  • To establish dynamic systems that ensure a transformative learning experience for students and foster an intellectually stimulating environment for academic and professional growth
  • To promote a culture of critical self-assessment, collegial review, and continuous improvement through the integration of quality principles and the systematic adoption of proven institutional practices

DBS Global University

At DBS Global University, we stand at the threshold of a new era in higher education—one where excellence is not confined to a single department, but woven into the very fabric of our institutional culture. The Office of Quality Initiatives (IQAC) was established as our institutional heartbeat, aligned with the visionary frameworks of UGC, NAAC, and the transformative National Education Policy 2020. We exist not merely to comply with guidelines, but to pioneer a holistic system of academic and administrative excellence where evidence drives every action, innovation fuels every initiative, and the voice of every stakeholder echoes through our corridors.

Quality assurance at DBS Global University is not hierarchical—it is collaborative. Every faculty member, every student, every parent, every alumnus, and every industry partner is a custodian of our excellence.

We are committed to ensuring that every graduate who leaves DBS Global University carries with them not just knowledge, but the confidence, competence, and character to lead, innovate, and contribute meaningfully to a rapidly changing world.

Together, let us build DBS Global University as a beacon of educational excellence—an institution where quality transcends compliance and becomes a lived reality for every member of our community.
