FAQs

Q1. What is BBA in Business Analytics?

Ans – It is a specialised undergraduate degree that combines business management education with training in data analysis, statistics, and tools like Excel, SQL, and Python to support business decisions.

Q2. Which are the best BBA Business Analytics colleges in Uttarakhand?

Ans – Leading options include DBS Global University, UPES, Graphic Era, IMS Unison University, Quantum University, and Tula’s Institute. The right choice depends on your budget, career goal, and curriculum preference.

Q3. What is the fee for BBA Business Analytics in Dehradun?

Ans – Total academic fees range from approximately ₹2.70 Lakhs at Tula’s Institute to ₹12.81 Lakhs at UPES for the full programme. DGU’s fee is ₹9.51 Lakhs. Always verify current fees with the institution.

Q4. Do I need maths to pursue BBA Business Analytics?

Ans – While not always mandatory for admission, a strong foundation in mathematics is highly recommended. The curriculum is quantitative and requires comfort with statistics and data.

Q5. Is CUET required for BBA Business Analytics admission?

Ans – CUET is accepted by most universities and can exempt you from internal entrance tests or interviews. DGU requires 80% in four core subjects or a CUET percentile of 60 or above.

Q6. Are scholarships available for Uttarakhand domicile students?

Ans – Yes. DGU offers a 25% Uttarakhand Domicile Scholarship on tuition fees. Other institutions also offer domicile-specific waivers. Verify eligibility with each university.

Q7. What jobs can I get after BBA Business Analytics?

Ans – Common entry-level roles include Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Marketing Analyst, Operations Analyst, and Business Intelligence Associate.

Q8. Is DBS Global University UGC-recognised?

Ans – Yes, DGU is approved by the UGC, and the degree is valid for jobs and MBA admissions.

label: MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management: Career Scope, Salary & Why It’s India’s Most Underrated MBA Specialization
html:
DGU Courses MBA MBA in Health Care

MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management: Career Scope, Salary & Why It’s India’s Most Underrated MBA Specialization

  • DBS Global University
  • September 23, 2026September 29, 2026
  • 0

Quick Answer: MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management prepares graduates for management and leadership roles across India’s rapidly expanding healthcare, hospital, pharmaceutical, and health-tech sectors. It suits students interested in hospital administration, pharmaceutical brand management, healthcare consulting, and health insurance operations — not clinical practice. DGU’s programme in this specialisation includes healthcare systems training, pharmaceutical management, digital health integration, and hospital administration as part of its curriculum.

While most MBA aspirants default to Finance, Marketing, or HR, one specialisation remains consistently overlooked despite a genuine and expanding industry behind it: MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management. India’s healthcare sector is growing at an unprecedented pace, and the pharmaceutical industry is projected to double in size by 2030. Someone has to manage that growth — the hospitals, the supply chains, the regulatory compliance, the brand portfolios. That is where this MBA fits in.

Table of Contents

  1. What Is MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management?
  2. Why Is It Called India’s Most Underrated MBA Specialization?
  3. Is India’s Healthcare & Pharma Industry Actually Growing?
  4. Which Is the Best College for MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management?
  5. Career Opportunities After MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management
  6. What Is the Salary After MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management in India?
  7. Skills Required for a Career in Healthcare & Pharma Management
  8. MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management vs MBA in Marketing
  9. How Is DGU Preparing Students for Healthcare & Pharma Careers?
  10. Future Scope of Healthcare & Pharma Management in India
  11. Government and Industry Bodies to Know
  12. Frequently Asked Questions

What Is MBA in Healthcare Management/Pharma Management?

An MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management is a two-year postgraduate programme that blends core business education — strategy, marketing, finance, operations — with specialised modules in hospital administration, healthcare policy, pharmaceutical management, healthcare economics, digital health, and regulatory affairs. It is a management degree, not a clinical or medical degree. The focus is on the business of healthcare: how hospitals operate, how pharmaceutical companies bring drugs to market, how health insurance systems function, and how healthcare organisations can deliver quality care efficiently.

Unlike a general MBA in Marketing or Operations, this specialisation addresses the unique characteristics of the healthcare sector — regulatory compliance (FDA, EMA, CDSCO), ethical considerations, patient-centric service delivery, supply chain complexity, and the growing influence of digital health technologies. Graduates learn to manage healthcare organisations while navigating the distinct regulatory, operational, and ethical landscape of the industry. The programme is structured across six trimesters with 102 credits and 1,020 total hours of learning, progressing from general management foundations to advanced healthcare administration and strategic healthcare management.

Why Is It Called India’s Most Underrated MBA Specialization?

Awareness of this specialisation remains strikingly low relative to the actual hiring need. Most Indian B-schools do not offer a dedicated MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management, and the few that do — such as DBS Global University, IIHMR Bangalore, and a handful of specialised institutes — operate outside the mainstream MBA conversation. This creates a paradox: the industry is expanding rapidly, healthcare organisations are hiring, but the talent pipeline is thin.

By contrast, Finance and Marketing seats at most B-schools are oversubscribed, producing a large pool of graduates competing for generalist roles. The healthcare and pharmaceutical sector, meanwhile, requires domain-specific knowledge that a general MBA does not provide — understanding of healthcare systems, regulatory frameworks, pharmaceutical marketing, hospital operations, and health insurance mechanisms. India needs at least 1.8 million additional doctors, nurses, and midwives to meet basic healthcare demand, and the country will need more than 11,000 additional health management professionals by 2030 to maintain a healthy ratio of health managers per population. The underrated status reflects low awareness among aspirants and a lack of structured programme offerings at scale — not weak career prospects.

Is India’s Healthcare & Pharma Industry Actually Growing?

Yes, and the data is unambiguous. The Indian pharmaceutical industry is currently valued at approximately USD 60 billion (Rs. 5.30 lakh crore) in FY26, and is projected to reach USD 130 billion by 2030, growing at a CAGR of over 10 per cent. India is the world’s third-largest producer of medicines by volume and supplies nearly 20 per cent of global generic medicines. Pharmaceutical exports surpassed USD 31 billion in FY26 despite global headwinds, demonstrating the sector’s resilience and international demand.

The healthcare delivery side is growing equally fast. India’s hospital sector was valued at approximately USD 98.98 billion in 2023 and is projected to reach close to USD 193.59 billion by 2032, growing at a CAGR of around 8 per cent. The Indian digital health market was valued at around USD 8.79 billion in 2024 and is projected to reach close to USD 47.8 billion by 2033, growing at a CAGR of 17.67 per cent. Medical tourism is also expanding — India’s medical value travel market was estimated at around USD 11.14 billion in 2025 and is expected to reach USD 12.32 billion in 2026, with projections of USD 22.11 billion by 2031.

The growth is not concentrated in metros alone. The expansion of Ayushman Bharat into tier-2 and tier-3 cities is driving hospital development beyond metropolitan centres. Apollo, Narayana Health, and Aster DM Healthcare are expanding into towns like Guntur, Nashik, Madurai, Raipur, Coimbatore, Salem, and Guwahati. Ayushman Bharat accounts for 48 per cent of revenue at hospitals in tier-2 and tier-3 cities, creating predictable patient flow and driving demand for trained healthcare managers in these regions.

Government support is a strong tailwind. The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes, the Bulk Drug Park policy, and Pharma Vision 2047 are pushing domestic manufacturing and innovation. Public health spending in India rose from about 1.2 per cent of GDP in 2020 to about 2 per cent of GDP in 2022, with a stated target of 2.5 per cent. These policy interventions signal long-term government commitment to the sector.

Which is the Best College for an MBA in Healthcare Management/Pharma Management?

There is no single “best” college — the right choice depends on your career goal, budget, and location preferences. For students seeking a programme that combines healthcare systems training, pharmaceutical management, digital health integration, and hospital administration within a structured MBA framework, DGU’s programme is a relevant option. The total programme fee at DGU for the 2026-28 batch is approximately Rs. 7.60 lakhs (tuition and compulsory charges), structured across six trimesters. The programme sits under the DBS School of Health Sciences and integrates core business management principles with specialised healthcare knowledge.

Other institutions offering related programmes include IIHMR Bangalore (PGDM in Pharmaceutical Management), DY Patil University Pune (MBA Pharmaceutical Management, total fees approximately Rs. 5.99 lakhs), and Jain University (MBA in Healthcare Management). Prospective students should verify current fees, placement data, and curriculum details directly with each institution.

Career Opportunities After MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management

Graduates typically enter roles in hospital administration, pharmaceutical brand management, healthcare consulting, health insurance operations, regulatory affairs, healthcare supply chain, and health-tech product management. Specific job titles include Hospital Administrator, Healthcare Operations Manager, Pharmaceutical Brand Manager, Healthcare Consultant, Health Insurance Manager, Regulatory Affairs Manager, and Health-Tech Product Manager.

Hiring is active across the sector. Novartis has posted Manager roles in Hyderabad requiring MBA degrees from premier institutes with 4-6 years of experience. Lifenity Health has recruited Management Trainee Business Analysts in Mumbai for candidates with MBA/PGDM in Healthcare Management. Amura Health has sought Medical Operations Managers in Chennai for MBA/MPH/Hospital Administration graduates. HLL Lifecare has posted Associate Manager and Business Manager roles for diagnostic business operations, requiring MBA in Healthcare Management or Hospital Administration. These are live listings from major healthcare organisations operating in India.

The breadth of the sector means graduates can work across hospitals and hospital chains, pharmaceutical companies, diagnostic chains, health insurance companies, health-tech startups, healthcare consulting firms (Deloitte, EY, PwC), medical device companies, and public health organisations. This diversity of opportunity is one of the key strengths of this specialisation — graduates are not locked into a single industry vertical.

What Is the Salary After MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management in India?

The salary outlook for healthcare and pharma management graduates is strong and growing. Freshers from reputed healthcare MBA colleges typically start between Rs. 5 to 8 LPA, while mid-level professionals with 4 to 7 years of experience earn Rs. 12 to 18 LPA. Senior leadership roles with 8 to 12 years of experience command Rs. 25 to 40 LPA. According to Glassdoor, healthcare management salaries in India range from INR 3,70,000 to 51,75,000 per annum, with an average annual salary of INR 15,00,000.

Job Role Salary Range (INR/Year)
Hospital Administrator ₹6 – 6.6 LPA
Healthcare Consultant ₹7.6 – 8.4 LPA
Operations Manager ₹10.8 – 11.9 LPA
Healthcare Project Manager ₹6.7 – 7.4 LPA
Medical Practice Manager ₹5 – 10 LPA
Healthcare Analyst ₹4.2 – 5 LPA

In pharmaceutical brand management specifically, salaries are competitive. Brand Manager salaries in the pharma industry range from Rs. 16.1 to 17.8 LPA with 2 to 13 years of experience. At GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals, Brand Managers earn Rs. 21.9 to 26.9 LPA, while at Sanofi they earn Rs. 14.7 to 22 LPA. Novartis Brand Managers earn Rs. 36.4 to 48.1 LPA, reflecting the premium commanded by experienced professionals in this segment. AmbitionBox data shows that Healthcare Manager salaries in India range from Rs. 7.3 to 8.5 LPA, with the top 10 per cent earning Rs. 13.8 LPA and the top 1 per cent earning over Rs. 35.4 LPA. In Mumbai specifically, Healthcare Manager salaries average Rs. 15,25,432 per year, which is 16 per cent higher than the national average. These figures demonstrate that compensation in this sector scales significantly with experience and specialisation.

Skills Required for a Career in Healthcare & Pharma Management

The skills that matter in this field blend commercial, regulatory, and clinical-adjacent competencies. Healthcare operations management is foundational — understanding patient flow, resource allocation, and quality standards (NABH, JCI). Pharmaceutical marketing and brand strategy are critical for roles in pharma companies, requiring knowledge of product lifecycles, market access, and pricing strategies. Regulatory affairs knowledge covers FDA, EMA, and CDSCO frameworks, which govern drug approvals and compliance. Healthcare finance and health economics are increasingly important, particularly as insurance penetration grows and hospitals face pressure to demonstrate value. Digital health and health informatics skills are rising in demand, given the rapid adoption of telemedicine, electronic health records, and AI-driven diagnostics. Finally, supply chain and logistics management is essential, especially in pharmaceutical distribution and hospital procurement.

MBA in Healthcare Management/Pharma Management vs MBA in Marketing

Dimension MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management MBA in Marketing
Core focus Hospital administration, pharmaceutical management, healthcare policy, digital health, regulatory affairs Broad marketing principles applicable across FMCG, tech, retail, services
Industry specificity High — targeted at hospitals, pharma, diagnostics, insurance, and health-tech Low to moderate — generalist, with specialisation possible later
Typical entry roles Hospital Administrator, Pharma Brand Manager, Healthcare Consultant, Insurance Operations Manager Marketing Executive, Brand Executive, Digital Marketing Analyst
Salary (fresher) ₹5 – 8 LPA ₹3 – 6 LPA (varies widely by institute and sector)
ROI consideration Higher if committed to healthcare sector; recession-resistant career path Broader applicability; lower risk if undecided
Career ceiling CEO of hospital chain, VP Pharma Marketing, Healthcare Practice Lead CMO or marketing leadership across industries

The ROI question is less about which degree pays more in absolute terms and more about fit and stability. Healthcare is inherently recession-resistant — demand for medicines and medical care remains stable regardless of economic cycles. Many B-school graduates who chose healthcare management over traditional marketing or finance specialisations report faster career progression because the talent pool is smaller and demand is consistently high. Hospitals and healthcare organisations frequently struggle to find qualified management professionals, giving those with the right training significant negotiating power.

How Is DGU Preparing Students for Healthcare & Pharma Careers?

DGU’s MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management is built around four programme pillars that directly address the industry’s talent requirements:

  • Healthcare Systems and Policy Excellence: The curriculum covers healthcare systems and policy, healthcare economics and financing, and healthcare quality management, ensuring graduates understand the regulatory and policy environment that governs healthcare delivery in India.
  • Hospital Administration and Operations: Core modules cover hospital planning and operations, healthcare supply chain and logistics, and health information systems, preparing graduates to manage the complex operational realities of hospitals and healthcare organisations.
  • Pharmaceutical Management Depth: The programme integrates pharmaceutical management modules covering drug development cycles, regulatory frameworks (FDA, EMA, CDSCO), pharmacovigilance, market access, and pharmaceutical brand strategy.
  • Digital Health Integration: Modules cover digital transformation in healthcare, including telemedicine operations, health informatics, AI applications in healthcare administration, and data-driven healthcare management.

The programme is offered under the DBS School of Pharmacy and Research, a specialised school focused on healthcare and pharmaceutical education. The programme is structured across six trimesters with 102 total credits and 1,020 hours of learning, progressing from general management foundation to advanced healthcare administration and strategic healthcare management. Practical learning is delivered through project-based courses, case studies, and collaboration with healthcare professionals. The university’s Career Development Cell facilitates placements with over 350 companies annually, with healthcare and pharma companies actively recruiting from campus.

Admissions for the 2026-28 batch are open, with accepted entrance exams including CAT, MAT, CMAT, XAT, GMAT, and the university’s own DGU Entrance Test (DGU-AT Online). The programme accepts graduates from science, pharmacy, nursing, biotechnology, medical, and business backgrounds.

For students also considering other specialisations, DGU offers a range of MBA programmes across disciplines, including the increasingly popular MBA in Digital Transformation.

Future Scope of Healthcare & Pharma Management in India

The future scope for this specialisation is tied directly to the trajectory of India’s healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors. By 2030, the pharmaceutical industry is expected to reach USD 130 billion, and the hospital sector is projected to approach USD 193 billion by 2032. Medical tourism is expected to reach USD 22.11 billion by 2031. The expansion of Ayushman Bharat into tier-2 and tier-3 cities is not a temporary trend — it reflects structural investment in healthcare infrastructure and access. As India deepens its position as the pharmacy of the world and expands healthcare delivery beyond metros, the demand for managers who understand both business fundamentals and the unique regulatory, operational, and ethical landscape of healthcare will only grow. This is not a niche gamble; it is a bet on one of the most essential and fastest-growing sectors in the Indian economy.

Government and Industry Bodies to Know

Pharmaceutical Export Promotion Council of India (PHARMEXCIL): An organisation under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry that promotes India’s pharmaceutical exports. PHARMEXCIL works with over 150 countries to ensure access to quality-assured Indian pharmaceuticals. For students and professionals in pharma management, PHARMEXCIL represents a critical industry body for understanding export trends, regulatory updates, and global market access.

Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India: The Ministry oversees healthcare delivery, public health programmes, and health policy in India. Its initiatives include Ayushman Bharat, the National Health Mission, and the National Digital Health Mission. These programmes directly shape the healthcare management landscape and create employment opportunities for trained healthcare managers.

Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO): India’s national regulatory body for pharmaceuticals and medical devices, responsible for drug approvals, clinical trials, and quality standards. Understanding CDSCO regulations is essential for anyone pursuing a career in pharmaceutical management, regulatory affairs, or healthcare compliance.

IBEF (India Brand Equity Foundation): A trust established by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, IBEF provides authoritative market data and industry reports on India’s healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors. It is a reliable source for current market size, growth projections, and investment trends for students and researchers preparing for careers or academic work in this field.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. What is MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management?

It is a two-year postgraduate management programme that combines core business education with specialised modules in hospital administration, healthcare policy, pharmaceutical management, healthcare economics, digital health, and regulatory affairs. It is a management degree, not a clinical or medical degree.

2. Is this program good for someone from a non-medical background?

Yes. The programme accepts graduates from any discipline, including business, commerce, science, and engineering. While students from pharmacy, nursing, biotechnology, and medical backgrounds may have an initial advantage in understanding clinical terminology, the curriculum is designed to bring all students up to speed on healthcare-specific knowledge.

3. What kind of jobs can I get after this MBA?

Typical roles include Hospital Administrator, Healthcare Operations Manager, Pharmaceutical Brand Manager, Healthcare Consultant, Health Insurance Manager, Regulatory Affairs Manager, and Health-Tech Product Manager.

4. What is the salary after MBA in Healthcare Management in India?

Freshers from reputed colleges typically start between Rs. 5 to 8 LPA. Mid-level professionals with 4 to 7 years of experience earn Rs. 12 to 18 LPA. Senior leadership roles with 8 to 12 years of experience command Rs. 25 to 40 LPA. Pharmaceutical Brand Managers can earn Rs. 16 to 48 LPA depending on the company and experience.

5. MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management vs MBA in Marketing — which has better ROI?

It depends on your career certainty and priorities. If you are committed to the healthcare sector and value recession resistance, the specialised MBA gives you a domain advantage that a general marketing MBA does not. Healthcare spending remains stable regardless of economic cycles, making this specialisation inherently more secure. If you want broader optionality, a general MBA in Marketing offers more flexibility.

6. Which companies hire healthcare and pharma management MBA graduates?

Companies hiring in this space include Apollo Hospitals, Fortis Healthcare, Narayana Health, Max Healthcare, Sun Pharma, Cipla, Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories, Novartis, GlaxoSmithKline, Sanofi, Deloitte, EY, PwC, and health-tech companies like Practo and PharmEasy.

7. Is MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management a recognized/legitimate specialization in India?

Yes, it is a legitimate specialisation offered by recognised universities and institutions in India, including DBS Global University, IIHMR Bangalore, DY Patil University, and Jain University. As with any programme, prospective students should verify accreditation and programme details directly with the institution.

8. Which is the best college for MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management?

There is no single “best” college. The right choice depends on your career goal, budget, and location. DGU’s programme is a relevant option for students seeking healthcare systems training, pharmaceutical management, digital health integration, and hospital administration within a structured MBA framework. Prospective students should verify current details directly.

9. What are the fees for this program at DGU?

The total programme fee at DGU for the 2026-28 batch is approximately Rs. 7.60 lakhs, which includes the one-time admission fee and tuition fees across trimesters. The annual tuition fee is Rs. 3,50,000 (Rs. 1,75,000 per semester). Examination fees are payable separately. Hostel accommodation is available separately.

10. Is the healthcare and pharma industry actually growing in India, or is this a niche/risky choice?

It is growing significantly. Industry analysts project the pharmaceutical industry will reach USD 130 billion by 2030, the hospital sector will reach USD 193.59 billion by 2032, and medical tourism will reach USD 22.11 billion by 2031. The expansion of Ayushman Bharat into tier-2 and tier-3 cities is creating new healthcare infrastructure and management roles across the country. This is not a niche gamble; it is a structural growth trend.

11. Why is MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management considered underrated in India?

Awareness is low because most Indian B-schools do not offer it, and the few that do operate outside the mainstream MBA conversation. The industry is expanding rapidly, but the talent pipeline is thin. India will need more than 11,000 additional health management professionals by 2030. The underrated status reflects low awareness, not weak career prospects.

12. Does DGU offer industry exposure as part of this program?

Yes. The programme includes practical learning through project-based courses, case studies, and collaboration with healthcare professionals. The university’s Career Development Cell facilitates placements with over 350 companies annually, and students undertake frequent industrial visits to pharmaceutical units and healthcare organisations in the Dehradun region.

13. What skills do you need for a career in healthcare and pharma management?

Healthcare operations management, pharmaceutical marketing and brand strategy, regulatory affairs knowledge (FDA, EMA, CDSCO), healthcare finance and health economics, digital health and health informatics, and supply chain and logistics management.

Ready to explore a career in healthcare and pharma management? Learn more about DGU’s MBA in Healthcare & Pharma Management programme, including curriculum details, admission requirements, and placement opportunities. Verify current fees and placement data directly with the admissions team before applying.

President's Message

Thank you for your interest in DBS Global University.

Our vision is to build a university that stands for academic excellence, innovation, and transformative learning. We believe education must go beyond degrees. It should shape capability, character, and confidence. Every school, every programme, and every faculty member works toward creating a learning experience that is practical, future focused, and deeply relevant to industry.

Our academic structure is designed to offer depth and flexibility. Whether a student chooses management, technology, media, liberal arts, agriculture, pharmacy, law, or future skills, the emphasis remains the same. Strong fundamentals, hands on exposure, and meaningful industry interaction. We integrate live projects, skill development, and real business engagement so that learning connects directly to careers and placements.

Innovation remains central to our approach. From AI integrated learning to modern teaching tools and research driven programmes, we constantly evolve to match the changing professional landscape. Our goal is to prepare students not just for their first job, but for long term growth in a dynamic world.

Campus life plays an equally important role. Clubs, cultural activities, events, and collaborative initiatives ensure that students grow as leaders and team players. The Dehradun setting offers a calm and inspiring environment that supports both academic focus and personal development.

We are also committed to contributing to society through research, consultancy, and partnerships with industry and development agencies. By working closely with small and medium enterprises and other stakeholders, we aim to support regional and national growth.

I invite you to be part of a university that values excellence, professional growth, global exposure, and continuous learning. Your journey here will be challenging, enriching, and deeply rewarding.

Best wishes

Mr. Mohit Aggarwal

M.M.S., B.Engg.

Vice Chancellor's Message

As the Vice Chancellor of DBS Global University, I am honoured to welcome you to an institution where innovation, excellence, and holistic development converge. Our commitment to nurturing creative thinkers and ethical leaders is unwavering, as we strive to provide an education that transcends traditional boundaries.

DBS Global University stands at the forefront of academic innovation by integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI into our curriculum. At DBS Global University, experiential learning is a cornerstone of our philosophy. Through hands-on projects, industry collaborations, and immersive learning experiences, we provide students with the tools to bridge the gap between theory and practice. Our interdisciplinary programs, enriched by modern infrastructure and a vibrant campus life, empower students to tailor their academic journeys to align with their goals and aspirations.

Our dedication to experiential and future-focused learning is further evidenced through our Career Development Cell, which facilitates placements with over 350 companies annually, offering milestone packages. Alongside academic rigor, we foster a rich campus environment that includes sports, cultural activities, international immersion programs, and student-led initiatives.

label: BCA with Dual Specialization
html:
Choose Any Two Specializations. Build Future-Ready Technology Careers.

The future belongs to professionals who can combine technology, Artificial Intelligence, data, digital experiences and application development.

At DBS Global University, the BCA with Dual Specialization programme is designed to prepare students for the next generation of technology careers through a future-focused, industry-aligned curriculum. Unlike conventional BCA programmes, students graduate with the rare combination employers now look for:

One Degree + Any Two Specializations + Industry Certifications

Students can choose any two specializations from:

  • Artificial Intelligence (with HCLTech)
  • Data Analytics (with HCLTech)
  • UI/UX Design
  • Mobile App Development
  • iOS Development (Premium Global Career Specialization)

This unique model lets students customise their own career pathway based on their interests and future aspirations.

A Degree Built for Where the Jobs Are Going

Technology careers are evolving rapidly, and tomorrow's employers want professionals who can combine coding, AI, data and digital-product skills. India is projected to need an estimated 8–10 million AI-skilled professionals by 2030 (NASSCOM), with data analytics, cloud and digital-product roles among the fastest-growing across every industry. Just as importantly, employers increasingly prefer multi-skilled professionals who can work across two domains which is exactly what this dual-specialization model is built to produce.

Example Career Combinations

A few of the pathways students can design with two specializations:

Specialization Combination Ideal Career Direction
AI + Data Analytics Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Analytics & Automation
AI + UI/UX Intelligent product design and AI-powered digital experiences
Data Analytics + Mobile App Development App analytics, product intelligence and digital business
UI/UX + Mobile App Development Digital product design and application development
AI + iOS Development AI-powered iOS apps and intelligent mobile products
Data Analytics + iOS Development App analytics and product intelligence on Apple platforms

The programme is designed to create professionals who are versatile, adaptable and industry-ready.

Why Choose BCA with Dual Specialization at DBS Global University?

At DBS Global University, students learn through a model that blends academic depth with real, hands-on implementation:

  • Strong computing foundations
  • Dual specialization model
  • Industry exposure with HCLTech
  • Practical projects and internships
  • AI-enabled learning ecosystem and modern technology labs
  • Apple-enabled campus with iOS development on offer

Students graduate with both academic depth and practical implementation skills.

Program Overview

Strong Computing Foundation

Students develop solid technical fundamentals through:

  • Programming in C, Python and Java
  • Object-Oriented Programming
  • Data Structures and Algorithms
  • Database Management Systems
  • Computer Networks
  • Operating Systems
  • Computer System Architecture
  • Web Technologies
  • Software Engineering

This foundation prepares students for evolving technology careers and future learning pathways.

Choose Any Two Specializations

1. Artificial Intelligence (with HCLTech)
Learn the technologies shaping the future of business and computing. Key learning areas include:

  • Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
  • AI Tools and Applications
  • Machine Learning and Deep Learning
  • AI and ML Applications
  • Agile Development Methodology

Industry advantage: students completing the AI specialization electives earn an HCLTech Industry Certification in addition to their university degree.

2. Data Analytics (with HCLTech)
Develop the skills to work with modern data ecosystems and analytics-driven decision-making. Students learn:

  • Fundamentals of Data Engineering
  • NoSQL Databases
  • Big Data Applications
  • Data Analytics and Visualization

Industry advantage: students completing the Data Analytics specialization electives earn an HCLTech Industry Certification alongside their university degree.

3. UI/UX Design
Design digital experiences that users love. Students gain exposure to:

  • User Experience (UX) Design
  • Visual Interface Design
  • Interaction Design
  • Usability Testing and Prototyping
  • Design Systems and Product Experience

Students learn how to create engaging, user-friendly digital products.

4. Mobile App Development
Build modern applications for a mobile-first world. Students learn:

  • Cross-platform Mobile App Development
  • App Security and Privacy
  • Cloud-integrated Mobile Applications
  • App Deployment and Optimization

Students gain practical skills in building scalable, modern applications.

5. iOS Development (Premium Global Career Specialization)
Build modern iOS applications for the premium Apple ecosystem. Students learn:

  • The Apple ecosystem and Swift
  • Cloud-integrated app development
  • AI-enabled applications
  • App Store deployment

Delivered in an Apple-enabled lab, this track positions students for high-value global mobile-development roles.

Dual Specialization + Certification Advantage
More than just a degree students graduate with:

  • A BCA degree from DBS Global University
  • Any two industry-relevant specializations
  • Additional HCLTech industry certifications (for AI and Data Analytics specialization electives)

This gives students a strong competitive advantage in placements and higher studies.

Learn Through Projects and Internships

The programme follows an experiential learning model. Students take part in 3 internships and 4 projects, with hands-on exposure to:

  • Live HCLTech industry projects
  • AI-enabled problem solving
  • Product and app development
  • Data-driven applications
  • Innovation challenges and collaborative learning

The emphasis throughout is on practical implementation and portfolio building.

Career Opportunities

Graduates are prepared for a wide range of roles across the technology sector:

Software and Technology
  • Software Developer
  • Application Developer
  • QA / Test Engineer
  • Full-Stack Associate
Artificial Intelligence and Analytics
  • AI Associate
  • Data Analyst
  • Business Intelligence Associate
  • Analytics Executive
  • Automation Specialist
Mobile and Product Technologies
  • Mobile App Developer
  • UI/UX Associate / Designer
  • Digital Product Designer / UX Engineer
  • Full-Stack Mobile Application Developer
  • AI-powered Product and Experience Specialist
Emerging Digital Roles
  • AI-enabled business solutions
  • Intelligent automation
  • Product analytics
  • Technology consulting

  • Breadth of Domain Knowledge : A broad understanding of related domains to apply their core expertise effectively.

This model equips graduates with a comprehensive skillset that is highly valued in the industry, making them versatile and adaptable professionals.

Student Engagement and Opportunities

Throughout their academic journey, students will engage in:

Procedure

  1. Students registering for scholarship should apply on the prescribed form avaliable with the institute or on website at the time of interview before confirmation of admission. Students who do not apply before confirmation of admission wlil not be eligible for merit scholarship.
  2. Students should submit photocopies of all mark sheets and certificates required as above for entitling the scholarship.
  3. Upon your official confirmation of admission with the DBSG, you wlil receive a formal scholarship offer letter / confirmation.
  4. The scholarship wlil be disbursed semester wise.
  5. In case the result of the previous semester has not been declared tlil the last date of submission of fees for the next semester, the student may provisionally submit fees equivalent to the last semester fees but in case falis to get the required marks wlil have to submit the balance fees.
  6. Whlie applying for a scholarship and fliling in the percentage of class XII marks, applicants are required to consider the aggregate of Best 4 core subjects in their XII boards (SUPW, Physical Education and Non Academic Subjects wlil not be considered).
  7. Scholarship amount will be calculated on General (basic) tuition fee for per semester and subsequently thereafter.

However the scholarship for 3rd semester onwards wlil be subject to:

In case any of the above criteria is not fulfliled the scholarship for the next semester wlil be withdrawn.

  1. 75% attendance to be maintained in each subject individually in the preceding semester. Please note that Third Semester Scholarship depends on First semester performance and Fourth semester Scholarship on second semester.
  2. 70% marks in cumulative score in all subjects.
  3. Students shall not be involved in any disciplinary action of misconduct where a penalty or fine is imposed by the Proctorial board.
  4. Students shall take a good moral character certificate from the course coordinator every year and submit the same with the Registrar.
  5. Students should give an undertaking of being avaliable at all time during the course for any brand ambassador activities and also in case of events/goodwlil programmes.
  6. There should be no discontinuation in study. In case of transfer to any other institute, the scholarship given wlil have to be refunded prior to issue of College Leaving Certificate.
  7. Students need to send a thank you letter to the Board of Trustees for the Generous Scholarship every semester.

html:
The GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery) at DBS Global University, Dehradun is a 3.5-year Diploma program designed to develop competent, compassionate, and professional nurses.

The program combines classroom learning, clinical practice, and research exposure to prepare students for diverse roles in healthcare, education, and community services both in India and abroad.

  • Salient Features
  • Advantage @DGU
  • Eligibility Criteria

Salient Features

Expert Faculty

Learn from doctors, nursing specialists, and experienced healthcare practitioners.

Modern Infrastructure

Well-equipped nursing labs, digital classrooms, and simulation-based learning.

Hands-on Clinical Training

Practical exposure in multi-specialty hospitals and healthcare centers.

Global Career Pathways

Guidance for international licensing exams such as NCLEX, HAAD, MOH, and IELTS.

Holistic Learning

Focus on patient care, leadership, communication skills, and ethical practices.

Placement Support

Strong tie-ups with leading hospitals and healthcare organizations for internships and jobs.

label: Career Development Cell
html:
The Career Development Cell prepares students for placements through clear direction and continuous practice. Students go through multiple hiring simulations before facing actual recruiters and learn how to build strong CVs, handle group discussions, and perform in interviews through mock sessions with detailed panel feedback from CDC mentors. Training is continuous, with repeated practice, focused correction, and improvement in every session. Students also interact with industry top leaders and recruiters to understand what companies expect and how to meet those expectations.

Each student is guided based on their strengths, with focused support to prepare for specific roles. With access to 350+ recruiters across Finance, Technology, Marketing, Supply Chain and HR, students get multiple opportunities to apply, improve, and secure roles they are prepared for.

What Students Gain :

  • Clarity on career direction based on strengths and interests.
  • Mentors from Industries, CXOs and Leaders.
  • Training in CV building, group discussions, and personal interviews.
  • Exposure to industry leaders and evolving career opportunities.
  • Access to placement opportunities across 50+ sectors.

CDC Support :

Career Discovery & Direction

At CDC, the focus is on helping individuals explore diverse career paths and understand evolving industry expectations from the very beginning. Through interactions with recruiters and industry professionals, clarity is built around required skills and the right starting point for each journey.

Skill Building & Preparation

CDC works on strengthening practical, job-relevant skills aligned with defined career goals. This includes support in CV development, mock interviews, group discussions, and hands-on training that reflects real industry standards.

Placement Readiness & Opportunities

CDC facilitates a structured placement process that opens access to a wide range of career opportunities. Continuous support is provided through interviews and selection stages, while ensuring the flexibility to explore different roles and make well-informed career choices.

Personalised Career Support :

Personalised Career Support

Each student is continuously evaluated through training sessions, mock interviews, and panel interactions conducted by the CDC team. Based on this, students receive:

  • Clear feedback on strengths and areas of improvement
  • Personalised guidance and career roadmaps
  • Focused preparation aligned with industry expectations
Industry Exposure

Students regularly engage with the professional world through:

  • Guest sessions by industry leaders
  • Corporate visits
  • Live projects and real-world assignments
  • Internship opportunities across domains
"These experiences help students understand how industries operate and what is expected from them in real roles."

Placement Opportunities :

With 350+ recruiters visiting the campus every year, students get access to opportunities across leading companies and sectors. Recruiters include Deloitte, EY, Infosys, HCLTech, and Tech Mahindra in tech and consulting, ICICI Bank and Axis Bank in finance, ITC Limited, Hindustan Unilever, and Dabur in consumer brands, and UltraTech Cement and Adani Cement in core sectors.

Our Students explore roles across diverse domains, including Finance, Analytics, Technology, Marketing, Human Resources, Consulting, Operations, Sales, Business Development, and Supply Chain. With the flexibility to apply across opportunities, the aim is to ensure the right fit, where individuals feel prepared and confident stepping into their roles.

label: BCA with Dual Specialization
html:
Choose Any Two Specializations. Build Future-Ready Technology Careers.

The future belongs to professionals who can combine technology, Artificial Intelligence, data, digital experiences and application development.

At DBS Global University, the BCA with Dual Specialization programme is designed to prepare students for the next generation of technology careers through a future-focused, industry-aligned curriculum. Unlike conventional BCA programmes, students graduate with the rare combination employers now look for:

One Degree + Any Two Specializations + Industry Certifications

Students can choose any two specializations from:

  • Artificial Intelligence (with HCLTech)
  • Data Analytics (with HCLTech)
  • UI/UX Design
  • Mobile App Development
  • iOS Development (Premium Global Career Specialization)

This unique model lets students customise their own career pathway based on their interests and future aspirations.

A Degree Built for Where the Jobs Are Going

Technology careers are evolving rapidly, and tomorrow's employers want professionals who can combine coding, AI, data and digital-product skills. India is projected to need an estimated 8–10 million AI-skilled professionals by 2030 (NASSCOM), with data analytics, cloud and digital-product roles among the fastest-growing across every industry. Just as importantly, employers increasingly prefer multi-skilled professionals who can work across two domains which is exactly what this dual-specialization model is built to produce.

Example Career Combinations

A few of the pathways students can design with two specializations:

Specialization Combination Ideal Career Direction
AI + Data Analytics Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Analytics & Automation
AI + UI/UX Intelligent product design and AI-powered digital experiences
Data Analytics + Mobile App Development App analytics, product intelligence and digital business
UI/UX + Mobile App Development Digital product design and application development
AI + iOS Development AI-powered iOS apps and intelligent mobile products
Data Analytics + iOS Development App analytics and product intelligence on Apple platforms

The programme is designed to create professionals who are versatile, adaptable and industry-ready.

Why Choose BCA with Dual Specialization at DBS Global University?

At DBS Global University, students learn through a model that blends academic depth with real, hands-on implementation:

  • Strong computing foundations
  • Dual specialization model
  • Industry exposure with HCLTech
  • Practical projects and internships
  • AI-enabled learning ecosystem and modern technology labs
  • Apple-enabled campus with iOS development on offer

Students graduate with both academic depth and practical implementation skills.

Program Overview

Strong Computing Foundation

Students develop solid technical fundamentals through:

  • Programming in C, Python and Java
  • Object-Oriented Programming
  • Data Structures and Algorithms
  • Database Management Systems
  • Computer Networks
  • Operating Systems
  • Computer System Architecture
  • Web Technologies
  • Software Engineering

This foundation prepares students for evolving technology careers and future learning pathways.

Choose Any Two Specializations

1. Artificial Intelligence (with HCLTech)
Learn the technologies shaping the future of business and computing. Key learning areas include:

  • Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
  • AI Tools and Applications
  • Machine Learning and Deep Learning
  • AI and ML Applications
  • Agile Development Methodology

Industry advantage: students completing the AI specialization electives earn an HCLTech Industry Certification in addition to their university degree.

2. Data Analytics (with HCLTech)
Develop the skills to work with modern data ecosystems and analytics-driven decision-making. Students learn:

  • Fundamentals of Data Engineering
  • NoSQL Databases
  • Big Data Applications
  • Data Analytics and Visualization

Industry advantage: students completing the Data Analytics specialization electives earn an HCLTech Industry Certification alongside their university degree.

3. UI/UX Design
Design digital experiences that users love. Students gain exposure to:

  • User Experience (UX) Design
  • Visual Interface Design
  • Interaction Design
  • Usability Testing and Prototyping
  • Design Systems and Product Experience

Students learn how to create engaging, user-friendly digital products.

4. Mobile App Development
Build modern applications for a mobile-first world. Students learn:

  • Cross-platform Mobile App Development
  • App Security and Privacy
  • Cloud-integrated Mobile Applications
  • App Deployment and Optimization

Students gain practical skills in building scalable, modern applications.

5. iOS Development (Premium Global Career Specialization)
Build modern iOS applications for the premium Apple ecosystem. Students learn:

  • The Apple ecosystem and Swift
  • Cloud-integrated app development
  • AI-enabled applications
  • App Store deployment

Delivered in an Apple-enabled lab, this track positions students for high-value global mobile-development roles.

Dual Specialization + Certification Advantage
More than just a degree students graduate with:

  • A BCA degree from DBS Global University
  • Any two industry-relevant specializations
  • Additional HCLTech industry certifications (for AI and Data Analytics specialization electives)

This gives students a strong competitive advantage in placements and higher studies.

Learn Through Projects and Internships

The programme follows an experiential learning model. Students take part in 3 internships and 4 projects, with hands-on exposure to:

  • Live HCLTech industry projects
  • AI-enabled problem solving
  • Product and app development
  • Data-driven applications
  • Innovation challenges and collaborative learning

The emphasis throughout is on practical implementation and portfolio building.

Career Opportunities

Graduates are prepared for a wide range of roles across the technology sector:

Software and Technology

  • Depth of Technological Knowledge : Specialized expertise in one core area of IT.
  • Breadth of Domain Knowledge : A broad understanding of related domains to apply their core expertise effectively.

This model equips graduates with a comprehensive skillset that is highly valued in the industry, making them versatile and adaptable professionals.

  • Working Professionals :
  • Should have secured minimum 65% marks or an equivalent CGPA in their undergraduate studies
  • Must have a minimum of 2 years of working experience and should be in a full-time job at present.
  • Full-Time Scholars :
  • Required to have a minimum of 60% marks in their undergraduate program.

Program Highlights

  • A 2-year (4-semester) curriculum emphasizing domain-specific knowledge, research skills, and thesis work.
  • Designed to build a strong foundation in applied research, with a focus on solving real-world problems.
  • Combines core courses, seminars, electives, and a major thesis project spread across two phases.
  • Begins with a 3-week induction program (UHV-I) to help students align with institutional values and research orientation.

Outcomes and Opportunities

Graduates of this program will emerge as research-oriented professionals, equipped with the skills necessary to:
  • Tackle complex engineering problems,
  • Contribute to innovative product development, and
  • Pursue Ph.D. or R&D roles in academia and industry.

This program is an ideal launchpad for professionals aiming for research-driven roles or those transitioning to advanced academic pursuits.

  • A pathway program for getting into Ph.D. with exemption in the coursework
  • The program will follow the same regulation as the Ph.D. program for assessment and delivery, including the role of DRC and SRC.
  • At least one subject in Sem 1 and Sem 2 will be offered through the Swayam Platform, which will be communicated to the students at the beginning of each semester.
  • PEOs, PSOs, and POs for the M.Tech CSE / M.Tech by Research Program.

The Program Educational Objectives (PEOs), Program Specific Outcomes (PSOs), and Program Outcomes (POs) for the proposed M.Tech CSE / M.Tech by Research were presented and discussed in detail. The committee emphasized the importance of aligning these elements with national academic standards and global expectations in postgraduate technical education. The Board of Studies approved the proposed PEOs, PSOs, and POs for the M.Tech CSE / M.TechCSE by Research program and forwarding them to the Academic Council for final approval.

Program Educational Objectives

  • PEO 1: Research Excellence: Student will develop strong research skills and contribute to solving real-world problems through original and high-impact research.
  • PEO 2: Scholarly and Professional Growth: Students will pursue doctoral studies, academic careers, or research and development roles in industry, contributing to the advancement of knowledge and technology.
  • PEO 3: Ethical and Interdisciplinary Leadership: Graduates will demonstrate leadership, ethical responsibility, and interdisciplinary collaboration in research and innovation for societal benefit .

Program Outcomes

  • PO1: Research Competence: Conduct independent and systematic research to investigate complex problems and contribute to new knowledge creation.
  • PO2: Literature and Gap Analysis: Critically review existing literature, identify research gaps, and formulate research problems with well-defined objectives.
  • PO3: Methodological Rigor: Apply appropriate research methodologies, experimental techniques, or theoretical models to analyse problems effectively.
  • PO4: Technical Communication: Communicate research outcomes effectively through technical writing, conference presentations, and peer-reviewed publications.
  • PO5: Data Analysis and Interpretation : Use advanced tools, data analysis techniques, and statistical methods to validate research hypotheses and interpret results.
  • PO6: Innovation and Originality: Demonstrate creativity and originality in developing solutions or prototypes based on research findings.
  • PO7: Ethics and Responsibility: Apply ethical principles and adhere to responsible research practices, including proper citation, data integrity, and authorship ethics.
  • PO8: Collaborative Research: Work effectively as an individual and as part of multidisciplinary research teams, fostering collaboration and knowledge exchange.
  • PO9: Impact Assessment: Evaluate the social, environmental, and technological impact of research outcomes on stakeholders and policy.
  • PO10: Lifelong Learning: Engage in continuous learning and stay updated with the latest research trends, technologies, and professional practices.

Program Specific Outcomes

  • PSO 1: Research Planning and Execution: Design and execute a research plan using advanced tools and methods, from proposal writing to thesis submission.
  • PSO 2: Publication and Dissemination: Publish quality research papers in reputed journals and conferences, and contribute to knowledge dissemination.
  • PSO 3: Industry and Societal Relevance: Develop research solutions that address contemporary challenges in industry or society, demonstrating translational value.

The integrated B. Tech CSE + MBA program seamlessly combines technical proficiency with advanced managerial skills, creating versatile professionals ready to navigate the complexities of the modern business landscape.

Provides rigorous training in engineering disciplines alongside strategic business courses, ensuring a holistic understanding of industry challenges. This unique fusion prepares for leadership roles to effectively bridge the gap between technology and business objectives. With a focus on innovation, problem-solving, and entrepreneurship, this program empowers individuals to thrive in dynamic careers, from technology management to entrepreneurial ventures, fostering a new generation of agile and visionary professionals.

Why Choose an Integrated Degree?

  • Combines technical expertise with business acumen
  • Prepares students for leadership roles in the tech industry
  • Focuses on technology management, consulting, and entrepreneurship

Salient Features

Experiential Learning

Project-Based Learning

Industry-Relevant Subjects

Regular updates to the curriculum to reflect the latest trends and technologies in the IT sector.

"T" Skillset Development

The hallmark of our programs is the "T" Skillset model. This approach ensures that students gain:

  • Depth of Technological Knowledge : Specialized expertise in one core area of IT.
  • Breadth of Domain Knowledge : A broad understanding of related domains to apply their core expertise effectively.

This model equips graduates with a comprehensive skillset that is highly valued in the industry, making them versatile and adaptable professionals.

Student Engagement and Opportunities

Throughout their academic journey, students will engage in:

  • Three Internships : Opportunities to work with leading companies, gaining valuable industry experience.
  • Four Projects : Collaboration on innovative projects that push the boundaries of current technology.
  • Industry Partnerships : Direct interaction with industry experts through seminars, workshops, and mentorship programs.

Lifelong Learning and Problem-Solving Abilities

Our programs are designed not only to impart theoretical knowledge but also to instil critical problem-solving skills and a commitment to lifelong learning. Graduates will be prepared to:

  • Adapt to Changing Technologies
  • Stay ahead in the fast-paced world of IT.
  • Innovate and Create
  • Develop intelligent solutions to complex problems.
  • Contribute to Society
  • Provide effective solutions for societal,
  • industrial, and research challenges.

Choose the Department of CSE, School of Advanced Computing at DBS Global University and become part of a dynamic community dedicated to shaping the future of computing. Our programs will empower you with the skills, knowledge, and experience needed to excel in your career and make a meaningful impact in the world of technology.

Why BBA at DBS Global University is Distinctive

The BBA at DBS Global University is designed to give students early academic direction, deeper industry alignment, and flexible career outcomes. Unlike conventional BBA programs, where specialization becomes visible only at a later stage, the DBS model introduces focused pathways early, allowing students to shape a clear career trajectory from the beginning.

  • Early specialization from the undergraduate stage: Students begin building domain identity early instead of waiting until the final year to decide their functional direction.

  • Two academic pathways: Students can pursue either the BBA or the BBA with Super Specialization, depending on how sharply they want to align the degree with a niche career path.

  • Major plus niche track advantage: A student can combine a major specialization, such as Marketing, Finance, Human Resources, or International Business, with a super specialization track in an emerging or high-demand area.

  • Additional credits for deeper career preparation: In the BBA with Super Specialization, students complete 9 additional credits through 3 extra courses during the first three years, creating greater depth without compromising the core business foundation.

  • Balanced curriculum architecture: The program integrates common core, school core, major specialization, super specialization, value-added courses, open electives, skill enhancement, communication, and project-based learning.

  • Future-ready fourth-year choices: In the fourth year, students can progress through one of four pathways: Honours, Research, Industry Attachment, or Start-up. This makes the program suitable for academic, professional, entrepreneurial, and research-oriented goals.

  • Global pathway advantage:In BBA Global, students gain structured international immersion through visits to two foreign universities in two different countries during Semester 2 and Semester 4. With 75 teaching hours in each month, a total of 18 credits transferred to DBS Global University, foreign industry exposure, and internship opportunities in the host countries after the immersion programs, the pathway creates a premium global learning experience within the BBA.

  • Integrated Future-Skills Micro-Credentials:The program embeds carefully aligned micro-credentials as value-added learning layers alongside core courses, enabling students to build practical expertise in tools and technologies such as analytics, digital platforms, project management, and business applications. This strengthens applied capability, digital readiness, analytical thinking, and overall employability across corporate, managerial, and entrepreneurial roles.

Students gain essential deep tech mastery and practical skills through:

Digital Fluency:

Integrates AI-driven tools and analytical methods into every module, ensuring practical proficiency in data-driven decision-making.

Applied Strategy:

Focuses on real-world challenges through mandatory Corporate simulations, live industry projects, and dedicated internshipsc, moving beyond theoretical knowledge.

Industry Integration:

Our curriculum is shaped by global alliances with tech giants like HCL Technologies, SAP, and SAS, ensuring graduates are trained on platforms and methodologies currently used by leading enterprises worldwide.

Global Acumen:

Cultivates a global perspective through case studies, cross-cultural team projects, and opportunities to utilise our International Academic Pathways.

The Graduates of the BBA program are prepared to lead with ethical insight and entrepreneurial agility, equipped not just to navigate, but to drive transformation across any sector of the global marketplace.

The MCA with specialization in Full Stack Development offers a comprehensive education in computer application development with a focus on full stack software development.

The curriculum combines front-end and back-end application development with competitive programming modules, providing students with hands-on experience. This program prepares graduates to design, develop, manage, and maintain applications to meet industry needs, enhancing their proficiency in user experience design and logic comprehension for complex business applications.

Salient Features

Experiential Learning

Emphasis on hands-on experience through labs, projects and internships.

Project-Based Learning

Courses designed around practical projects that solve real industry problems.

Industry-Relevant Subjects

Regular updates to the curriculum to reflect the latest trends and technologies in the IT sector.

"T" Skillset Development

The hallmark of our programs is the "T" Skillset model. This approach ensures that students gain:

  • Depth of Technological Knowledge : Specialized expertise in one core area of IT.
  • Breadth of Domain Knowledge : A broad understanding of related domains to apply their core expertise effectively.

This model equips graduates with a comprehensive skillset that is highly valued in the industry, making them versatile and adaptable professionals.

Student Engagement and Opportunities

Throughout their academic journey, students will engage in:

  • Three Internships : Opportunities to work with leading companies, gaining valuable industry experience.
  • Four Projects : Collaboration on innovative projects that push the boundaries of current technology.
  • Industry Partnerships : Direct interaction with industry experts through seminars, workshops, and mentorship programs.

label: Integrated B.Tech CSE + M. Tech
html:
The integrated B. Tech CSE + M. Tech program seamlessly combines technical proficiency with advanced managerial skills, creating versatile professionals ready to navigate the complexities of the modern business landscape.

Provides rigorous training in engineering disciplines alongside strategic business courses, ensuring a holistic understanding of industry challenges. This unique fusion prepares for leadership roles to effectively bridge the gap between technology and business objectives. With a focus on innovation, problem-solving, and entrepreneurship, this program empowers

individuals to thrive in dynamic careers, from technology management to entrepreneurial ventures, fostering a new generation of agile and visionary professionals.

Why Choose an Integrated Degree?

  • Combines technical expertise with business acumen
  • Prepares students for leadership roles in the tech industry
  • Focuses on technology, consulting, and entrepreneurship
  • Salient Features
  • Advantage @DGU
  • Course Structure
  • Fee Structure
  • Scholarship
  • Eligibility Criteria

Salient Features

Experiential Learning

Emphasis on hands-on experience through labs, projects and internships.

Project-Based Learning

Courses designed around practical projects that solve real industry problems.

Industry-Relevant Subjects

Regular updates to the curriculum to reflect the latest trends and technologies in the IT sector.

  • Optimum Student to Teacher Ratio
  • Faculty members with average experience 15 plus years
  • Blend of Experience in Academics, Research and Industry with International Exposure.
  • T Skills program
  • 3 Internships and 4 Projects
  • Training and teaching by Industry experts
  • Almost all the top Industry Visit the campus
  • Experiential Learning through project-based labs
  • Labs over collaborative platform used by the Industry
  • iOS Development at offering
  • Quality Education with Experience at worthwhile Cost!!!
"T" Skillset Development

The hallmark of our programs is the "T" Skillset model. This approach ensures that students gain:

  • Depth of Technological Knowledge : Specialized expertise in one core area of IT.
  • Breadth of Domain Knowledge : A broad understanding of related domains to apply their core expertise effectively.

This model equips graduates with a comprehensive skillset that is highly valued in the industry, making them versatile and adaptable professionals.

Student Engagement and Opportunities

Throughout their academic journey, students will engage in:

  • Three Internships : Opportunities to work with leading companies, gaining valuable industry experience.
  • Four Projects : Collaboration on innovative projects that push the boundaries of current technology.
  • Industry Partnerships : Direct interaction with industry experts through seminars, workshops, and mentorship programs.
  • Internships with Leading Tech Companies
  • Industry-Centric Research Projects
  • Faculty-Student Research Collaboration
  • Research Conferences and Publications
  • Soft Skills Training
  • Networking Mixers and Industry Panels
  • Alumni Mentorship Programs
  • Start-up Incubators/Accelerators
  • Innovation Challenges and Business Plans
  • Student-Led Technical Clubs
  • Interdisciplinary Courses and Minors
  • Community Engagement & Social Impact
Lifelong Learning and Problem-Solving Abilities

Our programs are designed not only to impart theoretical knowledge but also to instil critical problem-solving skills and a commitment to lifelong learning. Graduates will be prepared to:

  • Adapt to Changing Technologies
  • Stay ahead in the fast-paced world of IT.
  • Innovate and Create
  • Develop intelligent solutions to complex problems.
  • Contribute to Society
  • Provide effective solutions for societal,
  • industrial, and research challenges.

Choose the Department of CSE, School of Advanced Computing at DBS Global University and become part of a dynamic community dedicated to shaping the future of computing. Our programs will empower you with the skills, knowledge, and experience needed to excel in your career and make a meaningful impact in the world of technology.

Advantage @DGU

  • Dehradun - A Safe, Beautiful & Cosmopolitan Education City.
  • Bundle of Industry Integrated Value Added Certificates.
  • Students from 23 States & 5 Countries on campus.
  • Multiple Placements for all.
  • More than 350+ Companies for Campus Placement.
  • Possibilities of International Exposure.
  • Separate in campus Girls & Boys hostels with Modern Sporting & Gym facilities.

Career Opportunities

  • Technology Management
  • Product Management
  • Business Analyst
  • Consulting
  • Digital Marketing
  • Corporate Strategy

Procedure

  1. Students registering for scholarship should apply on the prescribed form avaliable with the institute or on website at the time of interview before confirmation of admission. Students who do not apply before confirmation of admission wlil not be eligible for merit scholarship.
  2. Students should submit photocopies of all mark sheets and certificates required as above for entitling the scholarship.
  3. Upon your official confirmation of admission with the DBSG, you wlil receive a formal scholarship offer letter / confirmation.
  4. The scholarship wlil be disbursed semester wise.
  5. In case the result of the previous semester has not been declared tlil the last date of submission of fees for the next semester, the student may provisionally submit fees equivalent to the last semester fees but in case falis to get the required marks wlil have to submit the balance fees.
  6. Whlie applying for a scholarship and fliling in the percentage of class XII marks, applicants are required to consider the aggregate of Best 4 core subjects in their XII boards (SUPW, Physical Education and Non Academic Subjects wlil not be considered).
  7. Scholarship amount will be calculated on General (basic) tuition fee for per semester and subsequently thereafter.

However the scholarship for 3rd semester onwards wlil be subject to:

In case any of the above criteria is not fulfliled the scholarship for the next semester wlil be withdrawn.

  1. 75% attendance to be maintained in each subject individually in the preceding semester. Please note that Third Semester Scholarship depends on First semester performance and Fourth semester Scholarship on second semester.
  2. 70% marks in cumulative score in all subjects.
  3. Students shall not be involved in any disciplinary action of misconduct where a penalty or fine is imposed by the Proctorial board.
  4. Students shall take a good moral character certificate from the course coordinator every year and submit the same with the Registrar.
  5. Students should give an undertaking of being avaliable at all time during the course for any brand ambassador activities and also in case of events/goodwlil programmes.
  6. There should be no discontinuation in study. In case of transfer to any other institute, the scholarship given wlil have to be refunded prior to issue of College Leaving Certificate.
  7. Students need to send a thank you letter to the Board of Trustees for the Generous Scholarship every semester.

label: Bachelor of Arts/Science (Honors/ Honors with Research)
html:
DBS Global University's BA/BS Liberal Studies programme is founded on a true Choice-Based Credit System (CBCS), offering students complete flexibility in Dual Specializations designing their academic journey. Students can opt for 3-year degree programmes or 4-year pathways (Honours / Honours with Research / Honours with Startup focus), aligned with NEP, enabling personalised academic and career pathways. During the programme students engage with subjects such as History, Geography, Political Science, English Literature, Psychology, Economics, Finance, Data Analytics, International Relations, Media Studies, Digital Communication, Cultural Studies, and Creative Arts.

The program also supports aspirants preparing for competitive examinations such as UPSC and IAS by building a strong foundation in humanities and social sciences along with critical awareness of current affairs.

Note: The nomenclature of the degree (BA or BS) will be determined by the combination of specializations chosen by the student and the corresponding credit distribution prescribed by the University. The final award of degree shall be subject to the academic regulations in force at the time of graduation.

Students can choose Dual Specializations from the following Disciplines

  • English Literature
  • Economics
  • Data Analytics
  • History
  • Political Science
  • Computer Science
  • Finance
  • Advertising
  • Psychology
  • Public Administration
  • Geography
  • International Relations
  • Sociology
  • Anthropology

Additionally, the curriculum incorporates experiential learning through three structured summer internships which provides experiential learning to the students:

  • Year 1: Community / social internship for grassroots exposure
  • Year 2: Skill-based internship aligned with chosen disciplines
  • Year 3: Advanced industry internship for career specialization

Advantage @ DGU

  • Dehradun - A Safe, Beautiful & Cosmopolitan Education City.
  • Industry-aligned value-added certification programs like SAP, SAS, NISM & more
  • Students from 23 States & 5 Countries on campus.
  • Multiple Placements for all.
  • More than 350+ Companies for Campus Placement.
  • International Exposure to 20+ countries.
  • On campus, Girls & Boys hostels with Modern Sporting & Gym facilities.

Why to choose BA/BS Liberal Studies at DBS Global University?

  1. Dual Specialization – Flexibility to pursue two interdisciplinary areas of interest for broader academic and career exposure.
  2. Multidisciplinary Curriculum – Study across humanities, social sciences, business, and emerging fields like data analytics and digital communication.
  3. Interdisciplinary Learning Approach – Integrates diverse subjects to build critical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving skills.
  4. UPSC & Civil Services Preparation Support – Strong foundation in core subjects aligned with civil services and other competitive examinations.
  5. Experiential Learning Opportunities – Includes social internship, industrial internship, and a capstone project for practical exposure.
  6. Industry-Relevant Skill Development – Focus on communication, analytical reasoning, research, and digital skills.
  7. Career Versatility – Opens pathways in corporate, public sector, media, research, and higher education.
  8. Global Perspective – Exposure to global pathways and contemporary academic trends.
  9. Research & Project-Based Learning – Encourages independent inquiry and real-world application through projects and assignments.
  10. Holistic Development – Emphasis on ethical reasoning, leadership, and well-rounded personality development.

Procedure

  1. Students registering for a scholarship should apply on the prescribed form available with the institute or on website at the time of interview before confirmation of admission. Students who do not apply before confirmation of admission will not be eligible for merit scholarship.
  2. Students should submit photocopies of all mark sheets and certificates required as above for entitling the scholarship.
  3. Upon your official confirmation of admission with the DBSG, you will receive a formal scholarship offer letter / confirmation.
  4. The scholarship will be disbursed semester-wise.
  5. In case the result of the previous semester has not been declared till the last date of submission of fees for the next semester, the student may provisionally submit fees equivalent to the last semester fees but in case fails to get the required marks, will have to submit the balance fees.
  6. While applying for a scholarship and filling in the percentage of class XII marks, applicants are required to consider the aggregate of Best 4 core subjects in their XII boards (SUPW, Physical Education, and non-academic subjects will not be considered).
  7. Scholarship amount will be calculated on general (basic) tuition fee for per semester and subsequently thereafter.
  8. No application for scholarships shall be entertained beyond 15th July 2025.

However, the scholarship for 3rd semester onwards will be subject to:

In case any of the above criteria is not fulfilled, the scholarship for the next semester will be withdrawn.

  1. 75% attendance to be maintained in each subject individually in the preceding semester. Please note that third-semester scholarship depends on first-semester performance and fourth-semester scholarship on second semester.
  2. 70% marks in cumulative score in all subjects.
  3. Students shall not be involved in any disciplinary action of misconduct where a penalty or fine is imposed by the proctorial board.
  4. Students shall take a good moral character certificate from the course coordinator every year and submit the same to the Registrar.
  5. Students should give an undertaking of being available at all times during the course for any brand ambassador activities and also in case of events/goodwill programs.
  6. There should be no discontinuation in study. In case of transfer to any other institute, the scholarship given will have to be refunded prior to issue of College Leaving Certificate.
  7. Students need to send a thank-you letter to the Board of Trustees for the generous scholarship every semester.
