Most Preferred Combination

BA Economics & Data Anayltics The combination of Economics with Data Analytics provides insights to students on economic theory with advanced quantitative techniques and data-driven approaches. It enables students to work across a wide range of economic fields, including development planning, public policy evaluation, financial markets, international trade, environmental sustainability, and social sector analysis. The curriculum focuses on econometrics, statistical methods, and computational modelling, empowering students to analyse large datasets and generate actionable insights. With training in tools such as Excel, R, and other analytical platforms, students develop expertise in predictive modelling, machine learning applications, and empirical research.
BA History & Political Science

The BA in History & Political Science program offers a rich academic journey, combining the exploration of historical narratives with a deep understanding of political structures. Delving into global history, studying significant events, cultural shifts, and societal transformations. Simultaneously, the program provides a comprehensive examination of political theories, ideologies, and contemporary global politics. Through comparative politics, analyse diverse governance models and societal dynamics. Practical skills in archival research and field excursions enhance the learning experience, connecting theoretical knowledge with real-world contexts.

BA Computer Science & Finance

The BA in Computer Science & Finance offers an interdisciplinary journey merging technology with financial expertise. It melds the technical acumen of computer science with financial literacy, empowering to navigate the modern financial landscape. This program emphasizes coding skills, data analysis, and financial principles, equipping graduates to innovate in banking, investment, or financial technology sectors. Gain insights into algorithms, financial modeling, and emerging fintech trends. The program bridges the gap between computational theories and financial strategies, fostering versatile professionals prepared to optimize financial operations using technological advancements, providing a competitive edge in today’s digital financial.

BA English Literature & Advertising

BA English Literature & Advertising seamlessly merges the richness of literary exploration with the strategic prowess of advertising. This unique program cultivates language proficiency and creative storytelling, empowers to master effective communication in the realm of advertising. With a focus on critical analysis and creative expression, the program highlights the nuances of literature and the dynamic landscape of advertising for diverse roles in the media and advertising industry.

BA Psychology & English Literature

The BA Psychology & English Literature program amalgamates the exploration of human behavior and linguistic analysis, creating a multidimensional learning experience. It delves into the complexities of the human psyche while fostering a deep understanding of literary theory and language dynamics. This interdisciplinary program offers a comprehensive perspective on cognition, emotions, and societal structures, complemented by the nuanced study of literature, language, and communication. Gain insights into human nature, enhancing analytical and critical thinking skills through the rich tapestry of psychological theories and literary masterpieces, setting a solid foundation for diverse career pathways and holistic personal development.

BA Political Science and International Relations

The BA in Political Science and International Relations at DBS Global University is a dynamic and comprehensive program that explores the intricate interplay of politics, governance, and global affairs. Through a diverse curriculum, gain deep understanding of political systems, international relations theories, and critical analysis of global issues. The program fosters analytical thinking, research skills, and a nuanced understanding of diplomacy. With a focus on contemporary challenges, it prepares for careers in diplomacy, government, international organizations, and various sectors where a profound understanding of political dynamics is crucial.

BA Political Science and Public Administration

With BA Political science and BA Public Administration students get exposure towards political systems and administrative processes, combining the study of political theory, governance, and international relations with practical insights into public policy and administration. Students gain exposure to policy analysis, public sector management, and contemporary governance challenges through projects and internships. With integrated support for UPSC and other competitive examinations, the programme prepares students for careers in civil services, public policy, research, and administrative roles, while also building a strong foundation for higher studies.

  • BA/BS Liberal Studies students at DGU have the unique opportunity to prepare for UPSC and other competitive examinations alongside their academic program.

Please note: The coaching fee will be charged separately. However, the University will provide a 20% contribution/scholarship towards the total coaching fee, making high-quality preparation more accessible to students.

These modules are designed to foster critical thinking, communication, research aptitude, and professional readiness, equipping students for both competitive exams and diverse career paths.

html:
The Master of Arts (MA) program at DBS Global University is designed for students who seek depth, clarity, and purpose in their academic and professional journey. Rooted in a strong foundation of the humanities and social sciences, the program goes beyond traditional learning by encouraging critical inquiry, independent thinking, and meaningful engagement with contemporary issues. With a flexible and interdisciplinary approach, students have the opportunity to explore and specialize in areas such as English Literature, Psychology, Economics, and related domains. The curriculum is thoughtfully structured to balance theoretical understanding with practical application, enabling learners to connect academic knowledge with real-world contexts.

Students can choose from the following MA Discipline

  • MA English Literature
  • MA Economics
  • MA Psychology
  • MA History

What sets the MA program apart at DBS Global University?

In DBS Global University MA Programme gives its emphasis on research, analytical skills, and academic writing. Students are guided through seminars, discussions, and project-based learning, culminating in a dissertation or capstone work that reflects their intellectual growth and area of interest. The program also fosters a global outlook while remaining grounded in local and societal realities. In addition, DBS Global University supports students in preparing for diverse career pathways, including academia, research, public policy, civil services, media, and corporate roles. The learning environment is collaborative and mentorship-driven, ensuring that each student receives personalized guidance throughout their journey.

Scholarship

Scholarships for Post Graduate Students 2026-27 intake
Merit Scholarship At Dbs Global University

Conditions Of Scholarship For 2026-2027 Intake Batch

This scheme is applicable for all applicants of the MBA program at DBS Global University who have a valid qualifying exam score and have secured a pre-specified minimum percentage in graduation.

All such students will be eligible for scholarship in tuition fees for the entire program as per the following scheme:

For Applicants with a valid score in CAT/XAT/MAT/CMAT (with min. 65% in graduation)

CAT/XAT Percentile (More than) 75 80 85 90 95 96 97 98 99
MAT/CMAT Percentile (More than) 90 95 97 98 - - - - -
Scholarship (as % of Tuition Fee) 20 30 40 50 60 70 80 85 90
For Postgraduate Program for M.Tech / MCA (Dr. S. K. Gupta Memorial Scholarship)

25% Scholarship on tuition fees

This scholarship is applicable till 31st July 2025.

Note

  • The Scholarships are open for the first 15 percent seats in each program on a first come first served basis.
  • No application for scholarships shall be entertained beyond 15th-July-2025.
  • Candidates should preferably send their scholarship applications along-with their admission registration forms.

Procedure

  1. Students registering for scholarship should apply on the prescribed form available with the institute in the beginning of the semester.
  2. Students should submit photocopies of all mark sheets and certificates required as above for entitling the scholarship.
  3. Students should give an indemnity bond specifying that he/she will not leave the course/degree programme in between the duration of the course/degree.
  4. Upon your official registration with the DBSGU, you will receive a formal scholarship offer letter / confirmation.
  5. The scholarship will be disbursed to you in two equal installments or as applicable.
  6. In case the result of the previous semester has not been declared till the last date of submission of fees for the next semester, the student may provisionally submit fees equivalent to the last semester fees but in case falis to get the required marks will have to submit the balance fees.
However the scholarship for 3rd semester onwards will be subject to :
  1. 75% attendance to be maintained in each subject individually in the preceding semester. Please note that Third Semester Scholarship depends on First semester performance and Fourth semester Scholarship on second semester.
  2. 60% marks in cumulative score in all the subjects.
  3. Students shall not be involved in any disciplinary action of misconduct where a penalty or fine is imposed by the Proctorial board.
  4. Students shall take a good moral character certificate from the course coordinator every year and submit the same with the Registrar.
  5. Students should give an undertaking of being available at all time during the course for any brand ambassador activities and also in case of events/goodwill programmes.
  6. There should be no discontinuation in study. In case of transfer to any other institute, the scholarship given will have to be refunded prior to issue of College Leaving Certificate.
  7. Students need to send a thank you letter to the Board of Trustees for the Generous Scholarship every semester.
  8. In case any of the above criteria is not fulfliled the scholarship for the next semester will be withdrawn.

Disclaimer

  • Notwithstanding anything under this Scholarship scheme, ESKAY EDUCATIONAL TRUST has sole discretion to edit, modify, change, update, continue or abandon the above-mentioned Scholarship going forward at any given point in time, without any prior written intimation. Management will be the final deciding authority for all scholarship decisions as stated in this specific disclaimer.
  • There is no concept of automatic renewal for next semester. The Sponsorship Committee shall decide every semester on a case-to-case basis, subject to the Scholarship Scheme if prevailing at the relevant time.
  • There should be no discontinuation in study. In case of discontinuation / transfer to any other institute, the scholarship given will have to be refunded prior to issue of college leaving certificate.
  • Please note that this communication is without prejudice to any rights of ESKAY EDUCATIONAL TRUST and this communication should not be considered as a waiver of any rights of ESKAY EDUCATIONAL TRUST in the applicants’ favour.

Career Opportunities

  • Academia & Research: Lecturer, Research Associate, Academic Writer, PhD Scholar
  • Civil Services & Government Sector: UPSC/State PCS, Policy Analyst, Government Officer, Administrative Roles
  • Public Policy & Think Tanks: Policy Researcher, Analyst, Consultant in national & international organizations
  • Corporate & Business Sector: HR Manager, Business Analyst, Corporate Trainer, Strategy & Consulting Roles
  • Media, Communication & Content Industries: Content Writer, Editor, Journalist, Digital Media Specialist, Copywriter
  • Psychology & Behavioral Sciences (for MA Psychology): Counselor, Clinical/Organizational Psychologist (with required licensing), Behavioral Analyst
  • Economics & Financial Sector (for MA Economics): Economist, Data Analyst, Banking & Financial Services, Market Research Analyst
  • Social Sector & Development: NGO Professional, Development Consultant, Program Manager, CSR Roles
  • Data, Research & Analytics: Data Analyst, Social Researcher, Survey Specialist, Research Consultant
  • International Careers: Roles in international organizations, diplomacy support, global research bodies
  • Creative & Cultural Industries: Publishing, Film & Media, Advertising, Cultural Management
  • Entrepreneurship & Startups: Social Entrepreneurship, Content Ventures, Consulting Startups

label: PhD (Doctor of Philosophy)
html:
A PhD is the highest level of academic qualification, involving advanced research in a chosen field of study. Offered in both Full-Time and Part-Time modes, the programme requires scholars to conduct original research, submit a substantial thesis, and successfully defend their work through a viva voce examination.

Renowned faculty members guide students through a personalized and collaborative learning experience, promoting interdisciplinary approaches. DBS Global University's commitment to global perspectives ensures an inclusive and diverse academic environment. With state-of-the-art facilities and a dynamic research community, the doctoral program at DBS Global University prepares students for impactful contributions to academia, industry, and society, positioning them as influential leaders in their chosen fields.

Introduction

Admissions to Ph.D. programs at DBS Global University campus are held twice a year, for the January and July sessions. The Ph.D. program is available in two formats: Full-time and Part-time, with no distance learning option. Regular participation in coursework, various interactions, and submission of progress reports through presentations is mandatory.

A Full-time Ph.D. scholar dedicates his/her full time to the program requirements, while a Part-time Ph.D. scholar balances their research with employment responsibilities. The minimum duration for a Full-time Ph.D. is three years, and for a Part-time Ph.D., it is Four years. The maximum duration for both formats is six years.

Part-time candidates must ensure their workplace provides the necessary facilities and infrastructure conducive to research. Additionally, they are required to have a Co-guide from their organization, subject to approval by the university authorities.

DBS Global University promotes interdisciplinary research and the exchange of ideas across various fields. Scholars may appoint a Co-guide from outside DBS Global University in accordance with university rules and due approvals. The primary Guide for the scholar will be a DBS Global University faculty member, selected based on the research topic and availability. Full-time Ph.D. candidates also have the opportunity to work as research fellows on prestigious ongoing research projects at the university.

Eligibility Criteria

Minimum Qualifications

Candidates seeking admission to the Ph.D. Program, whether full-time or part-time, must meet the following eligibility criteria

  • Master’s Degree: A Master’s degree from a recognized Indian or foreign university/institute in the relevant field with a minimum of 55% marks or an equivalent CGPA.
  • Bachelor’s Degree: A four-year Bachelor’s degree from a recognized Indian or foreign university/institute in the relevant field with a minimum of 75% marks or an equivalent CGPA.
  • Pre-1986 Bachelor’s Degree: Applicants who completed their first-year degree course (undergraduate course) by June 4, 1986, regardless of the duration, will be considered equivalent to those who completed a three-year first-degree course. Applicants with a two-year first degree who enrolled after June 4, 1986, must undergo a one-year bridge course, as per UGC notification dated August 17, 2015.
  • Professional Qualifications: Applicants with Chartered Accountancy (CA) qualifications from 'The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India' (ICAI), Cost and Works Accountancy from ICWAI, or Company Secretary qualifications from ICSI with a minimum of 55% marks or an equivalent grade are eligible for admission to Ph.D. Programs in the relevant field.
  • Foreign/NRI Applicants: Foreign/NRI applicants or those with a Master’s degree from a foreign university must provide an equivalence certificate from AIU along with their online application form.
  • Note: A relaxation of 5% in marks, from 55% to 50%, or a corresponding relaxation in grade, may be granted to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer)/Differently abled and other eligible categories, as per prevailing UGC Regulations; or to those who obtained their Master's degree prior to September 19, 1991

Exemption from PhD Entrance Test/Written Test

Candidates who have cleared an All India National Level Competitive Examination in the relevant field, such as NET of UGC/CSIR/ICAR (ASRB), ICAR-AICE-JRF/SRF (PhD), GPAT, ICMR, GATE, or DST-INSPIRE within the last 2 years* of the PhD session (January or July) they are applying for at DBS Global University, will be exempted from the written test of the Ph.D. Selection Process. These candidates must appear for the interview round only.

To be considered for exemption, candidates must submit a scanned copy of the issued certificate (not the scorecard) along with the application form or via email no later than two days before the PET date. Exempted candidates will receive a message of exemption on their admission microsite/admit card before the PET. Candidates who do not receive such a message must appear for the PET (Ph.D. Entrance Test).

Admission

Admission Procedure

Application and Sessions

Applications for Ph.D. programs at DBS Global University are accepted twice a year: January and July sessions.

Admission is available for both Full-time and Part-time Ph.D. programs.

Application Process

Applications must be submitted online only, along with required documents and an online payment of Rs 750/- via Credit/Debit card.

A single form applies to one program only and is valid for one session.

Transfers from other campuses are permitted once the application is submitted to DBS Global University and after the confirmation of seat availability, NoC is obtained from the parent university (from where the transfer is sought).

Step Action
1 Submit online application form with required documents and payment
2 Check application status on the Admission Microsite at NPF/ERP.
3 Download Schedule and Admit Card for the selection process
4 Appear for the Ph.D. Entrance Test (PET) and Interview
5 Check selection status on the Admission Microsite
6 Print the admission letter and confirm fee payment

Selection Process

The selection process consists of the Ph.D. Entrance Test (PET) and an Interview, following UGC Ph.D. guidelines.

Choose Your Program and Campus: At the start, carefully select your Ph.D. program.

The PET is a 90-minute test with 100 multiple-choice questions, divided into two sections

Section 1 General aptitude in research

Section 2 Subject-specific knowledge

Particular Component Questions Marks
Section 1 – General General Knowledge & Research Awareness, English Language, Logical Reasoning, Quantitative Analysis, Data Analysis and Interpretation 50 Questions 50 Marks
Section 2 – Subject Specific Questions from the specific Ph.D. program subject and related fields 50 Questions 50 Marks
Interview by FRC Only for PET Qualified and PET Exempted candidates - 30 Marks

Additional Information

Candidates will be informed about requirements related to their application, selection process dates, times, and venues via the Admission Microsite at www.dgu.ac or through the whatsapp.

An online admission letter will be available for printing within stipulated time of selection, detailing fee payment instructions, and commencement details.

Candidates applying for multiple Ph.D. programs must ensure they appear for the selection process of each program on different dates.

Admission Confirmation

Selected candidates will be notified via the Admission Microsite.

An online admission letter will be available for printing within stipulated time of selection, detailing fee payment instructions, and commencement details.

The admission offer is provisional, valid only for the specific program and academic session applied for, and will be cancelled if conditions are not fulfilled within the specified time.

Note : Working applicants must submit an NOC at the time of registration and orientation, within a month of selection.

Date of Registration

The registration date for Ph.D. candidates will correspond to the actual registration date for the respective July and January batches.

Residency Period

Full-Time Candidates: The minimum residency period in the Department/Constituent unit is typically three years.

Part-Time Candidates: There is no residency period, but attendance in Ph.D. coursework and other academic activities is mandatory as scheduled.

Attendance Requirement

Full Attendance: Ph.D. scholars (both Full-Time and Part-Time) are expected to maintain full attendance (100%) in each course.

Minimum Attendance: A minimum of 75% attendance in each course is required to be eligible for end-semester examinations

Promotion Requirement: Full-Time Ph.D. scholars must achieve at least 75% attendance out of the total working days each semester to avoid an "Unsatisfactory" Semester Progress Report.

Course Work

Compulsory Coursework: All Ph.D. candidates must complete the assigned coursework and pass a written examination.

Duration: The coursework period is typically a minimum of six months.

Duration: The coursework period is typically a minimum of six months.

Time Frame: Coursework must be completed within one semester, not exceeding one academic year from provisional registration.

Tentative Class Timings During Coursework Period

Ph.D. Full-Time: All working days, 9:15 am - 6:10 pm.

Ph.D. Part-Time: Saturdays and Sundays, 9:15 am - 6:10 pm.

Comprehensive Examination

Requirement: Upon completion of coursework, candidates must pass a comprehensive examination testing their knowledge in their research field and their academic preparation.

Format: The examination includes both written and oral components and is conducted by the concerned institution. A minimum Grade B+ (7 points on a 10-point scale) is required to pass.

Guidelines

Research Assistants (RAs) at DBS Global University

Fellowship and Appointment Details

Candidates who successfully complete their Ph.D. coursework with a minimum CGPA of 7.5 will be considered for appointment as Teaching Associates or Research Associates. These positions will involve a balanced engagement in teaching, research, and limited administrative responsibilities, contributing to the academic ecosystem of the university.

Selected candidates will receive a fellowship of INR 40, 000 per month.

Introduction

This document outlines the guidelines for the appointment and role of Research Assistants (RAs) at DBS Global University. The RAs will contribute to teaching and research projects while enhancing their academic growth under the mentorship of faculty members. The guidelines align with UGC norms and the standards followed by other premier institutions in India.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification : The candidate should hold a minimum of a Master’s degree in a relevant discipline with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade.

Research Aptitude: The candidate must have demonstrated interest in academic research through prior work, publications, or dissertations.

Application Process: The candidate must submit a completed application form, along with self-attested copies of educational credentials, and a statement of purpose (SOP) outlining their research interests.

Terms and Conditions

Fellowship

Fellowship: elected Research Assistants will receive a fellowship INR 40, 000 per month in the second year

This amounts to an average of INR 40, 000 per month over the three-year Research Assistantship period. The fellowship is subject to satisfactory research progress and academic engagement of at least 12 hours per week.

Duration

The appointment will be for the position of Research Assistant and subject to review after every year based on research progress and performance.

Review of Progress

Research performance will be reviewed biannually, with reports from the supervisor and academic evaluation. Continuation of the fellowship will depend on meeting the timeline of research deliverables and satisfactory completion of assigned tasks.

Coursework Completion

Research Assistants must complete any assigned coursework and maintain academic performance, achieving a minimum score of 6.5 on a 10-point scale.

Publication Requirements

RAs are required to publish at least two research papers in SCI/Scopus/Web of Science/UGC Care/ABDC indexed journals within the contract period, particularly in the first two years after completion of coursework

Research Domain and Topics

The Research Assistants will conduct research (PhD) on topics provided and approved by the Centre of Excellence (DGU) in their respective domains.

Working Hours, Attendance and Leaves

Working Hours

Working Hours - University offers flexible working expecting a minimum of 40 hrs spread over 6 days a week as per the University policy.

Attendance

RAs must mark their attendance in the university's biometric system as per the norms set for fulltime scholars. Attendance will be closely monitored, and absences without prior approval from the supervisor may lead to the discontinuation of the fellowship.

Leaves

Only Casual Leaves and Academic Leaves will be applicable to Research Assistants. For more details refer to University’s Leave Policy. All leaves need to be pre- sanctioned by the Supervisor and Dean Research. All holidays defined in the university’s holiday calendar can be availed in addition to leaves stated above. Any off-campus engagements related to research will require prior approval, and a formal leave of absence will be granted based on the supervisor's recommendation.

General Responsibilities of RAs

Assisting faculty members in their research projects, including data collection, analysis, and report writing.

Actively participating in workshops, seminars, and academic conferences organized by the university.

Contributing to the research community by engaging in discussions, sharing knowledge, and collaborating with other researchers and departments.

Evaluation and Feedback

Supervisors will provide biannual feedback on the Research Assistant's work, which will be used to determine the continuation or renewal of the appointment.

A formal assessment will be conducted at the end of the term to evaluate the RA’s contribution to research and their progress in academic development.

Discontinuation and Termination

The Research Assistant fails to achieve the minimum academic engagement of 6.5/10.

The RA does not meet the publication requirements within the stipulated period.

The RA fails to adhere to attendance requirements.

Any form of misconduct, violation of university regulations, or unethical research practices are reported.

Withdrawal or Resignation Clause

In the event that a Research Assistant (RA) seeks to withdraw from the PhD program or resign from the Research Assistantship, the following conditions will apply to protect the interests of DBS Global University:

Prior Notice: The RA must submit a formal written request for withdrawal or resignation at least two months in advance, along with a detailed explanation of the reasons for the decision.

Approval Process: The request will be subject to approval by the Dean Research and the respective research supervisor. The university reserves the right to deny or defer the resignation if the candidate’s ongoing research, funded projects, or academic responsibilities are critical.

Financial Liability

The RA will be required to refund any fellowship amounts disbursed during the preceding two months if their resignation is deemed detrimental to ongoing research projects.

Additionally, any costs incurred for academic training, conference participation, or other resources provided to the RA may be recovered as determined by the university.

Unfinished Research Work

The RA must provide a comprehensive progress report and submit any data, drafts, or research materials developed during their tenure at the university.

Exceptional Circumstances

In cases involving severe medical conditions or other unforeseen emergencies, the above conditions may be reviewed and waived at the discretion of the university's competent authority.

Conclusion

These guidelines are subject to periodic review and amendment by the university to ensure alignment with UGC norms and the evolving needs of research at DBS Global University. All Research Assistants are expected to uphold the highest standards of academic integrity and contribute meaningfully to the university’s research output.

label: BA Film and TV
html:
The Film Studies Program at DBS Global University offers a comprehensive and industry-focused education designed to prepare students for successful careers in the film and media industry.

With mentorship from acclaimed filmmakers like Dipankar Jojo Chai, Gautami Vegyaraju, Aseem Bajaj, Nakul Kamte, and Vikesh Bhutani, students gain unparalleled insights and practical experience.

The program is enhanced by a partnership with Dehradun's JSR Studios, providing access to state-of-the-art production facilities and equipment. The curriculum emphasizes hands-on learning, with students producing films annually, participating in industry projects, and gaining international exposure through film festivals. Additionally, the program offers free future skills certificates in areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Digital Marketing, and Machine Learning, ensuring graduates are versatile and highly employable. Located in Dehradun, a city known for its educational prominence and film-friendly policies, DBS Global University provides a supportive and enriching environment for aspiring film maker.

Mentored By Filmmakers

Our B.A. Film & New Media Production program is crafted with guidance from acclaimed filmmakers, providing students with unparalleled expertise and mentorship. Our industry ties with Mumbai's HK Studios Education & Purple People Labs ensure students learn from industry veterans like:

Dipankar Jojo Chai
(Satya Prem Ki Katha, Pink, Gulabo Sitabo, October)
Gautami Vegyaraju
(Bajirao Mastani, Sultan, Phillauri, Life Sahi Hai S2)
Aseem Bajaj
(Sacred Games, Golmaal, Runway 34, Bholaa)
Nakul Kamte
(Lagaan, Rang De Basant, Bhaag Milkha Bhaag)
Vikesh Bhutani
(Gully Boy, Dil Dhadakne Do, Fukrey, Mirzapur)
  • Salient Features
  • Advantage @DGU
  • Course Structure
  • Fee Structure
  • Scholorship
  • Eligibility Criteria

Salient Features

  • Expert Mentorship - Students receive mentorship from acclaimed filmmakers such as Dipankar Jojo Chai ("Pink"), Gautami Vegyaraju ("Bajirao Mastani"), Aseem Bajaj ("Sacred Games"), Nakul Kamte ("Lagaan"), and Vikesh Bhutani ("Gully Boy"), ensuring unparalleled learning and industry connections.
  • Industry-Grade Infrastructure - Our partnership with HK Studio Mumbai & Dehradun's JSR Studios provides access to state-of-the-art production facilities, offering hands-on experience with cutting-edge media technologies.
  • Experiential Learning - Students engage in practical projects, producing a film each year, with opportunities for premieres at multiplexes and participation in international film festivals. The curriculum includes real-world industry projects and internships.
  • Thriving Film Landscape - Dehradun's film-friendly policies and support from the Uttarakhand Film Development Council (UFDC) make it an emerging hub for filmmakers, offering incentives like tax benefits and exemption of shooting charges.
  • Student-Friendly Environment - Dehradun's affordable living costs, safe environment, and excellent educational infrastructure provide a conducive atmosphere for students, complemented by homely residential facilities at DBS Global University.

Advantage @DGU

  • Dehradun - A Safe, Beautiful & Cosmopolitan Education City.
  • Bundle of Industry Integrated Value Added Certificates.
  • Students from 23 States & 5 Countries on campus.
  • Multiple Placements for all.
  • More than 350+ Companies for Campus Placement.
  • Possibilities of International Exposure.
  • Separate in campus Girls & Boys hostels with Modern Sporting & Gym facilities.

Career Opportunities

  • Film Director
  • Cinematographer
  • Screenwriter
  • Film Editor
  • Television Producer
  • Production Manager
  • Sound Designer
  • Film Critic

label: BA Digital Media & Mass Communications
html:
The BA in Digital Media & Mass Communication at DBS Global University is a future-ready, experience-driven undergraduate program that brings together the power of media, strategy, and digital marketing.

This program is not confined to the classroom. It’s built for students who want to create stories, drive campaigns, influence audiences, and lead conversations in the fast-changing media world. With its unique integration of journalism, branding, content creation, and digital platforms, the course is designed to nurture complete media personalities - equipped to speak, write, design, and influence across all formats.

By combining the classic principles of mass communication with the tools and techniques of modern marketing, students gain the agility to work in newsrooms, agencies, studios, startups, and corporate environments. It’s not just a media degree - it’s a launchpad for the next generation of strategic communicators.

The program stands out through its curriculum that goes beyond conventional learning-integrating SaaS-based tools, Google & Meta Ads, performance analytics and industry-standard software. With annual CAPSTONE projects, students gain hands-on, experiential knowledge that makes them industry-ready from day one. Whether it’s digital marketing, journalism, public relations or media production, the program unlocks limitless career pathways for aspiring media professionals.

  • Salient Features
  • Advantage @DGU
  • Course Structure
  • Fee Structure
  • Scholorship
  • Eligibility Criteria

Salient Features

  • SaaS-Based Learning Tools - Students engage with industry-relevant SaaS tools such as Canva Pro, HubSpot, Grammarly Premium, Hootsuite, and more—enhancing their practical learning through professional-grade platforms.
  • Google & Meta Advertising Certifications - Hands-on training in running ad campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and YouTube Studio—with certification pathways to add credibility and career advantage.
  • Industry-Linked Capstone Projects (Every Year) - Each academic year culminates in a Capstone Project, where students collaborate with brands, NGOs, or startups to design, execute, and evaluate media campaigns—building portfolios and confidence.
  • Analytics & Performance Tools - Students are trained in Google Analytics, Meta Insights, Hotjar, and SEMRush, equipping them with the analytical mindset to interpret data and measure communication impact.
  • Experiential & Studio-Based Learning - Live projects, newsroom labs, green screen studios, podcasting zones, and on-field reporting opportunities provide students with immersive exposure to the media ecosystem. Through hands-on experience with production setups, PR simulations, and live coverage, students actively engage in the end-to-end creation of news stories, podcasts, campaigns, and other creative content
  • Career-First Curriculum with Expert Mentorship - The curriculum is curated with feedback from top media professionals and includes regular guest lectures, internship support, industry visits, and alumni mentorship to ensure real-world readiness.

Advantage @DGU

  • Dehradun - A Safe, Beautiful & Cosmopolitan Education City.
  • Bundle of Industry Integrated Value Added Certificates.
  • Students from 23 States & 5 Countries on campus.
  • Multiple Placements for all.
  • More than 350+ Companies for Campus Placement.
  • Possibilities of International Exposure.
  • Separate in campus Girls & Boys hostels with Modern Sporting & Gym facilities.

Career Opportunities

Graduates of the BA in Digital Media & Mass Communication at DBS Global University are uniquely equipped to succeed in a wide spectrum of media, communication, and marketing careers. This program develops multi-skilled professionals ready to lead in fast-paced environments across industries.

  • Content Writer / Copywriter
  • Digital Marketing Strategist / SEO Specialist
  • Community Manager / Audience Engagement Lead
  • Social Media Manager / Influencer Marketing Head
  • Advertising Creative / Campaign Strategist
  • Scriptwriter / Creative Producer
  • News Anchor / Broadcast Journalist
  • Video Content Creator / YouTube Strategist
  • Brand Communication Executive / Manager
  • Photojournalist / Multimedia Storyteller
  • Corporate Communications Specialist
  • Graphic Designer / Visual Media Executive
  • Public Relations Officer (PRO)
  • Podcast Producer / Host
  • Media Planner / Media Analyst / Insight Strategist

html:
The B. Pharm lateral entry program is a three-year undergraduate course that provides in-depth knowledge of pharmaceuticals, drug formulation, and clinical practices.

About the Program

The Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) program at the DBS School of Pharmacy and Research, under DBS Global University, is a four-year undergraduate program that provides comprehensive knowledge of pharmaceutical sciences, drug development, formulation, pharmacology, and pharmaceutical analysis. The program combines theoretical learning with extensive laboratory training, research exposure, and industry-oriented education to prepare students for professional roles in the pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors.

Duration : 3 years (Direct admission to 2nd year).
  • USPs of the Program
  • Advantage @DGU
  • Scholarship
  • Eligibility Criteria

USPs of the Program

  • Practical Experience - Practical experience in B. Pharm equips students with hands-on training in pharmaceutical formulation, drug analysis, and clinical pharmacy. It includes laboratory experiments, industrial visits, and hospital training to enhance real-world skills. Students learn about quality control, pharmacovigilance, and patient counselling through internships. This experience bridges academic knowledge with professional pharmacy practice.
  • Licensing and Certification - Graduates can register with the State Pharmacy Council, obtaining a license to practice as a registered pharmacist. A registered pharmacist can work as professional in community pharmacies, hospitals, pharmaceutical industries, and government sectors.
  • Career Opportunities - Individuals with a B. Pharm qualification can find employment in various healthcare settings, such as community pharmacies, hospital pharmacies, retail pharmacies and pharmaceutical companies. Monitor and evaluate the safety of medications, ensuring adverse drug reactions are reported and analysed.
  • Industry-Aligned Curriculum - The program is approved by regulatory bodies and aligned with the pharmaceutical industry to ensure students gain relevant, up-to-date pharmaceutical knowledge.
  • Updated Laboratories & Research - Hands-on learning in advanced pharmaceutical labs equipped with modern instruments for drug formulation, quality control and clinical research.
  • Comprehensive Learning Approach - A balanced mix of theoretical knowledge, practical training and exposure to real-world applications, including formulation design, pharmacology, medicinal chemistry and clinical pharmacy.
  • Experienced Faculty & Mentorship - Learn from well-qualified professors and industry professionals who provide personalised guidance and mentorship.
  • Career & Global Opportunities - Pharmacy graduates can pursue careers in pharmaceutical companies, clinical research, hospital pharmacies, pharmacovigilance, regulatory agencies, or opt for higher studies in pharmacy & healthcare.

Procedure

  1. Students registering for scholarship should apply on the prescribed form avaliable with the institute or on website at the time of interview before confirmation of admission. Students who do not apply before confirmation of admission wlil not be eligible for merit scholarship.

  4. The scholarship wlil be disbursed semester wise.
  5. In case the result of the previous semester has not been declared tlil the last date of submission of fees for the next semester, the student may provisionally submit fees equivalent to the last semester fees but in case falis to get the required marks wlil have to submit the balance fees.

However the scholarship for 3rd semester onwards wlil be subject to:

In case any of the above criteria is not fulfliled the scholarship for the next semester wlil be withdrawn.

  5. Students should give an undertaking of being avaliable at all time during the course for any brand ambassador activities and also in case of events/goodwlil programmes.
  6. There should be no discontinuation in study. In case of transfer to any other institute, the scholarship given wlil have to be refunded prior to issue of College Leaving Certificate.

SAP (Systems, Applications, and Products) in Data Processing, is a German multinational software corporation that develops enterprise software solutions to help businesses manage their operations and customer relations effectively.

Salient Features

  • ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) - SAP ERP is a comprehensive suite of applications that integrates core business functions, such as finance, procurement, manufacturing, and human resources, into a unified system. It facilitates real-time data sharing across different departments.
  • SAP S/4HANA - S/4HANA is the next-generation ERP suite from SAP. It is built on the SAP HANA in-memory database, providing faster data processing, real-time analytics, and a simplified data model. S/4HANA is designed to run in the cloud or on-premises.
  • SAP Business Suite - The SAP Business Suite includes modules like SAP ERP, SAP CRM, SAP SRM (Supplier Relationship Management), and SAP SCM (Supply Chain Management). These modules work together to streamline business processes and improve efficiency.
  • SAP Business Intelligence (BI) - SAP BI solutions, including SAP BusinessObjects, provide tools for reporting, analytics, and data visualization. Users can create dashboards, reports, and perform ad-hoc analysis to make informed business decisions.
  • SAP Fiori - SAP Fiori is a user experience (UX) design approach that provides a set of design principles and apps to create a consistent and intuitive user interface for SAP applications. Fiori apps are responsive and can be accessed on various devices.
  • SAP HANA - SAP HANA is an in-memory database platform that accelerates data processing and analytics. It allows organizations to analyze large volumes of data in real-time, improving the speed of reporting and decision-making.
  • SAP Cloud Platform - SAP Cloud Platform is an open platform-as-a-service (PaaS) that provides unique in-memory database and application services. It enables organizations to build, deploy, and manage applications in the cloud.
  • SAP Leonardo - SAP Leonardo is an integrated system of software and services that incorporates next-gen technologies such as the Internet of Things (IoT), machine learning, artificial intelligence (AI), and blockchain into the SAP Cloud Platform.
  • SAP Industry Solutions - SAP offers industry-specific solutions tailored to the needs of various sectors, including manufacturing, retail, healthcare, utilities, and more.

SAP's software solutions are widely used by businesses of all sizes globally, offering a range of tools to optimize and automate key business processes. The modular nature of SAP's offerings allows organizations to choose and integrate the solutions that best fit their specific needs.

SAS is a global software company that provides advanced analytics, AI and data management solutions to organizations across industries.

Why get SAS Certified?

Globally Recognized Certification Earn a globally-recognized certification to advance your career, increase recognition, and boost your confidence—leading to higher salaries and more job opportunities.

Prove your credibility SAS certifications are globally recognized, so having them on your resumé proves you've received in-depth training from industry experts.

Gain a career advantage SAS skills are highly in demand among today's employers. Learning – and validating – those skills can lead to new opportunities.

  • USPS of the Program
  • Advantage @DGU
  • Level & Duration

USPS of the Program

  • Analytics and Statistics - SAS offers a wide range of statistical and analytical capabilities for data analysis, including descriptive statistics, regression analysis, time series analysis, clustering, and predictive modeling.
  • Business Intelligence (BI) - SAS provides tools for data visualization, reporting, and dashboarding to help businesses gain insights from their data. SAS Visual Analytics and SAS Visual Statistics are examples of BI tools offered by SAS.
  • Data Management - SAS Data Management solutions enable organizations to integrate, cleanse, transform, and manage data from various sources. This includes data integration, data quality, master data management (MDM), and data governance.
  • Advanced Analytics - SAS offers advanced analytics capabilities, such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), and optimization algorithms. These tools are used for predictive modeling, forecasting, and decision optimization.
  • Big Data Analytics - SAS provides solutions for analyzing large volumes of data, including support for distributed computing frameworks like Hadoop and integration with cloud-based data platforms.
  • Data Visualization - SAS Visual Analytics and SAS Visual Statistics offer interactive data visualization capabilities for exploring and presenting data visually. Users can create dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate insights effectively.
  • Text Analytics - SAS Text Analytics enables organizations to extract insights from unstructured text data, such as social media posts, customer reviews, and documents. It includes capabilities for sentiment analysis, entity extraction, and topic modeling.
  • Risk Management and Fraud Detection - SAS provides solutions for risk management, fraud detection, and regulatory compliance in industries such as banking, insurance, and healthcare. These solutions use advanced analytics to identify patterns and anomalies indicative of fraud or risk.
  • Customer Intelligence - SAS Customer Intelligence solutions help businesses understand and engage with their customers more effectively. This includes customer segmentation, marketing analytics, and personalized recommendations.

SAS is widely used across industries and sectors for data analysis, business intelligence, and advanced analytics. Its comprehensive suite of tools and capabilities makes it a popular choice for organizations looking to extract insights, drive decision-making, and gain a competitive edge through data-driven strategies.

AI-Powered Learning Ecosystem

Turning AI into your ultimate professional advantage

Welcome to the forefront of educational innovation at DBS Global University, where we believe that understanding technology is no longer optional but it is essential. Our commitment to preparing future-ready leaders is reflected in how we seamlessly embed Artificial Intelligence (AI) across our entire academic ecosystem.

Here is how we are empowering the next generation to master the AI revolution.

AI-Integrated Curriculum

At DBS Global University, AI is not treated as an isolated tech subject. Instead, we have integrated AI into the curriculum of every single discipline. Whether you are studying finance, management, humanities, or the sciences, you will explore how AI is transforming that specific field. This cross-disciplinary approach ensures that all students understand how to maximize the benefits of AI, streamline workflows, and leverage data-driven insights in their future professions.

FinanceManagementHumanitiesSciences

Prompt Engineering

To truly harness the power of artificial intelligence, one must know how to communicate with it effectively. To ensure our students possess this critical modern skill, we offer a dedicated subject in Prompt Engineering to all students across the university. In this course, you will learn the precise art and science of writing prompts, enabling you to extract high-quality, accurate, and highly optimized outputs from advanced AI models.

Core SubjectAll StudentsApplied Skill

A Community of Innovators

The DBS AI Cell (DAC)

Innovation thrives in community, which is why we established the DBS AI Cell (DAC). The DAC is a vibrant hub of AI enthusiasts, researchers, and students who constantly explore the boundaries of emerging technologies.

This specialized cell dedicates itself to digging deep into the latest tech developments and discovering how AI can be implemented best in both academic settings and real-world industry scenarios.

DAC

Join us at DBS Global University and discover how we turn AI from a futuristic concept into your ultimate professional advantage.

  • Salient Features
  • Advantage @DGU
  • Level & Duration
  • Approaches to AI
  • Applications of AI
  • Ethical Considerations

Salient Features

  • Machine Learning (ML) - a. ML techniques include supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning.
  • Deep Learning - Deep Learning is a type of machine learning that involves neural networks with many layers (deep neural networks). It has shown significant success in tasks such as image and speech recognition.
  • Natural Language Processing (NLP) - NLP enables computers to understand, interpret, and generate human language. It is used in applications like chatbots, language translation, and sentiment analysis.
  • Computer Vision - Computer Vision focuses on enabling machines to interpret and make decisions based on visual data. It is used in image and video recognition, object detection, and autonomous vehicles.
  • Robotics - AI is applied in robotics to develop intelligent systems capable of performing tasks in the physical world. This includes autonomous robots, drones, and robotic process automation.
  • Expert Systems - Expert Systems mimic the decision-making abilities of a human expert in a specific domain. They use rule-based systems to provide solutions and recommendations.
  • Reinforcement Learning - Reinforcement Learning involves training agents to make decisions by rewarding or penalizing them based on their actions in an environment. It is commonly used in gaming, robotics, and optimization problems.

Advantage @DGU

  • Dehradun - A Safe, Beautiful & Cosmopolitan Education City.
  • Bundle of Industry Integrated Value Added Certificates.
  • Students from 23 States & 5 Countries on campus.
  • Multiple Placements for all.
  • More than 350+ Companies for Campus Placement.
  • Possibilities of International Exposure.
  • Separate in campus Girls & Boys hostels with Modern Sporting & Gym facilities.

Level & Duration

Level

Certificate

Duration

1 Year

Approaches to AI

  • Narrow/Weak AI - Narrow AI is designed to perform a specific task or a narrow range of tasks. Examples include virtual personal assistants and image recognition systems.
  • General/Strong AI - General AI aims to have machines exhibit the same level of intelligence as humans across a broad range of tasks. Achieving strong AI remains a long-term goal.
  • Artificial Narrow Intelligence (ANI) - ANI refers to AI systems that are designed for a specific task and cannot perform tasks beyond their designed scope.

Applications of AI

  • Healthcare - Diagnosis and treatment recommendation, personalized medicine, predictive analytics.
  • Finance - Fraud detection, algorithmic trading, credit scoring, customer service chatbots.
  • Retail - Demand forecasting, recommendation systems, inventory management.
  • Automotive - Autonomous vehicles, predictive maintenance, traffic management.
  • Education - Personalized learning, intelligent tutoring systems, automated grading.
  • Entertainment - Content recommendation, gaming AI, virtual assistants.
  • Manufacturing - Predictive maintenance, quality control, supply chain optimization.
  • Smart Cities - Traffic management, waste management, energy optimization.
  • Cybersecurity - Threat detection, anomaly detection, behavior analysis.
  • Human Resources - Recruitment processes, employee engagement, talent management.

Ethical Considerations

  • Bias and Fairness - AI systems can inherit biases from training data, leading to unfair or discriminatory outcomes.
  • Transparency - Understanding and interpreting the decision-making process of AI systems can be challenging, leading to concerns about transparency.
  • Privacy - The use of AI in data analysis raises privacy concerns as personal information may be used to make predictions or recommendations.
  • Job Displacement - Automation and AI advancements may lead to job displacement in certain industries, raising concerns about economic impact.
  • Security - The increasing reliance on AI in critical systems raises concerns about potential vulnerabilities and security threats.

As AI continues to evolve, ethical considerations and responsible development practices are crucial to ensure the responsible and beneficial integration of AI technologies into various aspects of our lives. Ongoing research, collaboration, and discussions are essential to address the challenges and harness the potential benefits of artificial intelligence.

Building the Next Generation of Digital Storefronts: E-Commerce at DGU

The global digital marketplace is a complex ecosystem of real-time cloud architecture, dynamic user interfaces, secure payment funnels, and automated supply chains. At DBS Global University, mastering this space means moving far beyond the pages of a textbook.

Our specialized training program ensures students don't just study the theory of digital business — they build it from scratch.

The DGU Edge

Complete experiential learning

We break down the wall between classroom concepts and live deployment. Every student transitions from a consumer of digital platforms to a creator of architecture.

Phase 1

Core Architecture & Interface Design

Students dissect front-end user experiences, map consumer journeys, and understand the core tech stacks that anchor scalable online marketplaces.

Phase 2

Industry-Led Deep Dives

Top-tier executives and tech leads lead intense technical modules covering API integrations, payment gateways, and inventory algorithms — live-market nitty-gritty.

Phase 3

End-to-End Platform Engineering

Under direct industry mentorship, students take full-stack responsibility — designing, developing, testing, and deploying entire functional e-commerce platforms.

Why this program changes the game

100% execution-focused

Curriculum delivery covers structural design, high-volume data handling, and technical troubleshooting — not just managing an online shop.

Direct industry delivery

Learn from specialists who scale platforms daily. Industry experts bring real-world challenges, live case studies, and proprietary workflows straight to the lab.

Ready for the future skills economy

Graduates step into the corporate arena fully prepared to lead digital transformation roles, manage supply chains, and optimize conversion metrics from day one.

Ready to engineer the future of retail?

Discover how our technology-driven business specialization equips you with the agile skills needed to excel in the global digital landscape.

  • Salient Features
  • Advantage @DGU
  • Level & Duration

Salient Features

Types of E-commerce
  • B2C (Business-to-Consumer) - In B2C e-commerce, businesses sell products or services directly to consumers. Examples include online retail stores, subscription services, and digital product sales
  • B2B (Business-to-Business) - B2B e-commerce involves transactions between businesses. This can include wholesale trade, procurement platforms, and supply chain management.
  • C2C (Consumer-to-Consumer) - C2C e-commerce facilitates transactions between individual consumers. Online marketplaces, auction sites, and peer-to-peer platforms fall into this category.
  • C2B (Consumer-to-Business) - C2B occurs when individual consumers sell products or services to businesses. This can include freelance services, influencer marketing, and user-generated content.
Key Components of E-commerce
  • Online Storefront - The digital platform where products or services are displayed and transactions take place.
  • Shopping Cart and Checkout - Users can add items to a virtual shopping cart and proceed to checkout, where payment and shipping information is provided.
  • Payment Gateways - Secure systems that process online transactions, enabling the transfer of funds between buyers and sellers.
  • Inventory Management - Systems that track and manage product availability, preventing overselling and ensuring accurate stock levels.
  • Security Measures - SSL encryption, secure payment processing, and other security protocols to protect customer information.
  • Order Fulfillment - Processes for packing, shipping, and delivering products to customers.
  • Customer Relationship Management (CRM) - Tools for managing customer interactions, providing support, and building relationships.
E-commerce Platforms

E-commerce businesses often use platforms like Shopify, WooCommerce (WordPress), Magento, and others to set up and manage their online stores.

Mobile Commerce (M-commerce)

The use of mobile devices (smartphones, tablets) for online shopping and transactions. M-commerce often involves mobile apps and optimized websites.

Digital Marketing and SEO

E-commerce relies on digital marketing strategies such as search engine optimization (SEO), social media marketing, email marketing, and online advertising to drive traffic and sales.

Customer Experience

Providing a seamless and user-friendly experience is crucial. This includes easy navigation, clear product information, and responsive customer support.

Logistics and Shipping

Efficient logistics and shipping processes are essential for delivering products to customers in a timely and cost-effective manner.

E-commerce Trends
  • Personalization - Tailoring the online shopping experience based on individual preferences and behavior.
  • Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Chatbots - Using AI for product recommendations, virtual assistants, and automated customer support.
  • Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) - Allowing customers to visualize products in their real-world environment before making a purchase.
  • Subscription E-commerce - Offering products or services on a subscription basis, providing convenience and recurring revenue.
  • Voice Commerce - Using voice-activated devices for shopping and product searches.
Challenges in E-commerce
  • Security Concerns - Cybersecurity threats, data breaches, and fraud.
  • Competition - Intense competition in the online marketplace.
  • Regulatory Compliance - Adhering to various regulations related to e-commerce operations.
  • Supply Chain Disruptions - Challenges in managing and optimizing supply chains, especially during unforeseen events.

E-commerce has become an integral part of the global economy, offering businesses new opportunities and consumers greater convenience. The industry continues to evolve with technological advancements and changing consumer behaviors, shaping the way people buy and sell products and services online.

  • Students from 23 States & 5 Countries on campus.
  • Multiple Placements for all.
  • More than 350+ Companies for Campus Placement.
  • Possibilities of International Exposure.
  • Separate in campus Girls & Boys hostels with Modern Sporting & Gym facilities.

Mastering Modern Product Delivery Ecosystems

The global tech sector does not operate on rigid, outdated management structures. It runs on speed, iteration, and cross-functional velocity. This specialization trains students to manage complex product development cycles, eliminate delivery bottlenecks, and act as elite scrum masters.

The Scrum Master Workflow

Framework Fundamentals & Story Architecture

Students unpack the Agile Manifesto, transitioning from linear project tracking to iterative delivery. They learn to construct actionable user stories, establish acceptance criteria, and map comprehensive product backlogs.

Ceremony Execution & Velocity Tracking

Students take turns acting as Scrum Masters, running live daily stand-ups, structuring sprint planning sessions, and calculating team velocity metrics to ensure predictable software releases.

Enterprise Tooling & Jira Infrastructure

The training moves into production environments. Students build dynamic Scrum and Kanban boards in Jira, managing epic linkages, burnout charts, and retrospective action items.

Agile

Agile Philosophy
  • Values - Agile is based on the Agile Manifesto, which outlines four key values and twelve principles. The values prioritize individuals and interactions, working solutions, customer collaboration, and responding to change.
  • Flexibility - Agile emphasizes adaptability and the ability to respond to changing requirements and customer needs efficiently.
  • Continuous Delivery - The goal is to deliver a working product incrementally and regularly throughout the development process.
Agile Methodologies
  • Various Agile methodologies exist, such as Scrum, Kanban, Extreme Programming (XP), and more.
  • Teams can choose and tailor Agile practices to fit their specific needs and project requirements.
  • Agile methodologies promote iterative development, collaboration, and customer feedback.

Scrum

Scrum Framework
Roles
  • Scrum Master: Facilitates the Scrum process, removes impediments, and ensures the team follows Scrum practices.
  • Product Owner: Represents the customer and defines product features. Prioritizes the product backlog.
  • Development Team: Crossfunctional team responsible for delivering potentially shippable increments of the product.
Artifacts
  • Product Backlog: A prioritized list of features and user stories that the team will work on.
  • Sprint Backlog: A subset of the product backlog chosen for a specific sprint.
  • Increment: The sum of all the product backlog items completed during a sprint.
Events
  • Sprint Planning: Planning meeting at the beginning of each sprint to define the work to be done.
  • Daily Standup: Short daily meeting for the team to discuss progress and plan the day's work.
  • Sprint Review: Review of the completed work at the end of a sprint.
  • Sprint Retrospective: Reflection on the past sprint to identify areas for improvement
Scrum Principles
  • Empirical Process Control - Scrum is based on transparency, inspection, and adaptation. Teams continuously inspect their work and adapt based on feedback.
  • Iterative Development - Work is done in fixed-length iterations called sprints, typically lasting two to four weeks.
  • Self-Organizing Teams - Scrum encourages teams to be self-organizing and cross-functional.
  • Collaboration - Frequent communication and collaboration among team members, stakeholders, and customers are crucial.

Agile vs Scrum

  • Agile is a broader methodology or philosophy emphasizing flexibility and iterative development. It encompasses various methodologies, including Scrum.
  • Scrum is a specific framework within the Agile methodology. It provides a structured approach with defined roles, events, and artifacts to implement Agile principles.
  • Agile can be applied to various industries beyond software development, while Scrum is specifically designed for managing software development projects.

In summary, Agile is a mindset and philosophy, while Scrum is a specific implementation of Agile principles in the context of project management and software development. Many organizations adopt both Agile principles and Scrum practices to enhance their ability to deliver high-quality products with greater efficiency and adaptability.

html:
The Computational Core of Professional Data Science

The modern data economy requires a dual fluent approach to coding: the mathematical modeling precision of R combined with the robust, production-grade deployment capabilities of Python. This dual-language programming track prepares students to manipulate massive, high-velocity data layers.

The Programming & Data Engineering Matrix

Tool/Layer Core Academic Focus Corporate Deployment Application
Python Ecosystem Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn scripting Production-grade automation, API integration, pipeline construction
R Language Tidyverse, ggplot2, advanced econometric modeling High-density statistical analysis, data visualization, academic research models
Data Architecture SQL schemas, JSON structures, ETL workflows Cleaning and restructuring fragmented enterprise databases for real-time analysis

The Predictive Modeling Pipeline

Advanced Vector & Array Manipulation

Students learn to bypass inefficient loops by writing vectorized code blocks in R and utilizing NumPy arrays in Python to process millions of operations concurrently.

Statistical & Econometric Forecasting

Leveraging R’s computational engines, students design time-series models, execute multiple linear regressions, and build robust multivariate forecasting frameworks.

Production Scripting & Automation Pipelines

Using Python, students build end-to-end data pipelines that autonomously extract messy web data, clean structural inconsistencies, and output standardized files for corporate reporting.

Big Data

Definition

Big Data refers to extremely large and complex datasets that traditional data processing tools and methods may struggle to handle. It involves managing, processing, and extracting valuable insights from massive volumes of structured and unstructured data.

Characteristics
  • Volume - Big Data involves vast amounts of data, often ranging from terabytes to petabytes or more.
  • Velocity - Data is generated at high speed, often in real-time or near real-time.
  • Variety - Data comes in various formats, including text, images, videos, and more.
  • Veracity - The reliability and quality of the data can vary.
  • Value - Extracting meaningful insights from Big Data can provide significant value for businesses and decision-making.
Technologies and Tools
  • Hadoop - An open-source framework for distributed storage and processing of large datasets.
  • Spark - A fast and general-purpose cluster-computing system for Big Data processing.
  • NoSQL Databases - Database systems like MongoDB, Cassandra, and HBase designed to handle large volumes of unstructured data.
  • Data Lakes - Repositories that store vast amounts of raw data in its native format until needed.
Applications

Big Data is used in various industries, including finance, healthcare, e-commerce, and more, for purposes such as predictive analytics, fraud detection, and personalized recommendations.

Python

Programming Language

Python is a versatile, high-level programming language known for its readability and ease of use.

Data Science and Analytics

Python has become one of the most popular programming languages in the field of data science and analytics.

Libraries for Data Science
  • NumPy and Pandas - For numerical computing and data manipulation.
  • Matplotlib and Seaborn - For data visualization.
  • Scikit-learn - For machine learning algorithms and modeling.
  • TensorFlow and PyTorch - For deep learning.
Integration with Big Data Tools

Python is widely used in Big Data processing with tools like PySpark (Python API for Apache Spark) and integration with Hadoop.

Web Development and Automation

Python is extensively used in web development frameworks (Django, Flask) and for automation tasks.

Community and Ecosystem

Python has a large and active community, contributing to a rich ecosystem of libraries and frameworks.

R

Statistical Programming Language

R is a programming language and environment designed for statistical computing and graphics.

Data Analysis and Visualization

R is widely used for statistical analysis, data visualization, and exploratory data analysis.

Libraries for Statistics
  • dplyr and tidyr - For data manipulation and cleaning.
  • ggplot2 - For creating sophisticated data visualizations.
  • lm() and glm() - For linear and generalized linear modeling.
Integration with Big Data Tools

R has connectors and packages that enable integration with Big Data platforms, such as Rhipe for Hadoop.

Bioinformatics and Research

R is commonly used in fields like bioinformatics and academic research for statistical analysis.

Shiny

Shiny is an R package that allows interactive web applications to be created directly from R scripts.

Community and Packages

R has a strong community of statisticians and data scientists, and it offers a vast collection of packages for various statistical analyses.

Python vs R

  • Flexibility - Python is a general-purpose language used in various domains, while R is specialized for statistical computing.
  • Syntax - Python has a straightforward and readable syntax, making it easy for beginners. R is focused on statistical analysis, and its syntax reflects this specialization.
  • Ecosystem - Python has a broader ecosystem, including extensive libraries for web development, automation, and machine learning. R excels in statistics and data visualization.
  • Community - Both Python and R have active communities, and the choice between them often depends on specific project requirements and personal preferences.

In the field of data science, both Python and R are widely used, and the choice between them depends on factors such as the nature of the analysis, the available libraries, and the preferences of the data scientists and analysts involved. Many professionals in the field use a combination of both languages based on the task at hand.

label: NISM Certifications
html:
DBS Global University (DGU) offers students the opportunity to earn industry-recognised certifications from the National Institute of Securities Markets (NISM), an educational initiative of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI).

 
Through our tie-up with NISM, students can pursue the following certifications:
 
  • NISM Series V-A: Mutual Fund Distributors
  • NISM Series VIII: Equity Derivatives
  • NISM Series X-A: Investment Adviser
  • NISM Series XV: Research Analyst
  • NISM Series XXI-A: Portfolio Management Services (PMS)
  • And many more…

DGU is among the leading universities in India in terms of the number of NISM-certified students. Our learners are successfully working with top corporates across the globe, supported by strong academic foundations and mentorship from experienced faculty with rich industry backgrounds.

Residential Learning Experience at NISM Campus Mumbai

Students at DGU also benefit from a full-time residential programme that offers an exclusive learning opportunity at the NISM Mumbai campus. This immersive experience allows them to engage directly with market experts, participate in hands-on training sessions, and gain real-time exposure to India’s financial ecosystem. It provides a strong platform for students to build industry-relevant skills and develop a deeper understanding of capital markets.

Salient Features

  • NISM Series I - Currency Derivatives Certification Examination This certification is for professionals involved in currency derivatives markets. It covers topics such as currency markets, trading strategies, and risk management.
  • NISM Series II A - Registrars to an Issue and Share Transfer Agents Corporate Certification This certification is for professionals working in registrar and transfer agent (RTA) services. It covers the regulatory framework, processes, and operational aspects of RTAs.
  • NISM Series III A - Securities Intermediaries Compliance (Non-Fund) Certification Examination This certification is for compliance officers and employees of securities intermediaries. It covers compliance-related topics such as regulations, ethics, and risk management.
  • NISM Series IV A - Interest Rate Derivatives Certification Examination This certification is for professionals involved in interest rate derivatives markets. It covers topics such as interest rate products, trading strategies, and risk management.
  • NISM Series V A - Mutual Fund Distributors Certification Examination This certification is for individuals involved in the distribution of mutual funds. It covers topics such as mutual fund basics, regulatory framework, and investment advisory process.
  • NISM Series VI - Depository Operations Certification Examination This certification is for professionals working in depository operations. It covers topics such as depository systems, processes, and regulatory requirements.
  • NISM Series VII - Securities Operations and Risk Management Certification Examination This certification is for professionals involved in securities operations and risk management. It covers topics such as settlement processes, risk management, and regulatory requirements.
  • NISM Series VIII - Equity Derivatives Certification Examination This certification is for professionals involved in equity derivatives markets. It covers topics such as options, futures, trading strategies, and risk management.
  • NISM Series IX - Merchant Banking Certification Examination This certification is for professionals working in merchant banking activities. It covers topics such as regulatory framework, IPO process, and corporate restructuring.
  • NISM Series X A - Investment Adviser (Level 1) Certification Examination This certification is for individuals providing investment advisory services. It covers topics such as investment products, financial planning, and regulatory compliance.

These certifications are designed to enhance the knowledge, skills, and professionalism of individuals working in the securities markets in India. They are recognized by regulatory authorities and industry participants alike.

label: International Logistics
html:
Managing the Velocity of Global Commerce

Physical goods must move as fast as digital data. This operational specialization breaks down the complex global systems required to source components, manage manufacturing lead times, and deliver products across international borders with maximum efficiency.

Global Trade Corridors

Multimodal Transportation Networks

Students map out efficient transport routes, balancing maritime container shipping, air freight, and rail networks to minimize global transit times.

Customs Clearance & Trade Compliance

Deep study of international trade regulations, customs documentation, import/export compliance frameworks, and Incoterms that govern global cargo handoffs.

Strategic Hub Orchestration

Learn the analytics of warehousing, inventory distribution systems, automated fulfillment center design, and cross-docking mechanics to prevent supply chain chokepoints

  • Salient Features
  • Advantage @DGU
  • Level & Duration

Salient Features

  • Global Supply Chain Management - Understanding the entire supply chain, from the point of origin to the end-user, and how it operates on a global scale.
  • Trade Regulations and Compliance - Knowledge of international trade regulations, customs procedures, and compliance requirements to ensure smooth cross-border transactions.
  • Transportation and Freight Management - Learning about different modes of transportation (air, sea, land) and how to optimize the movement of goods efficiently and cost-effectively.
  • Inventory Management - Balancing inventory levels to meet demand while minimizing costs, taking into consideration factors like lead times and fluctuations in demand.
  • Warehousing and Distribution - Managing storage facilities, distribution networks, and order fulfillment processes across different countries.
  • Risk Management - Identifying and mitigating risks associated with global logistics, including geopolitical, economic, and environmental factors.
  • Technology in Logistics - Utilizing technology such as logistics software, tracking systems, and data analytics to enhance efficiency and visibility in the supply chain.
  • International Trade Finance - Understanding financial aspects of international trade, including payment methods, letters of credit, and currency exchange.
  • Cross-cultural Communication - Dealing with cultural differences, language barriers, and other communication challenges that arise in an international business environment.
  • Sustainability and Corporate Social Responsibility - Addressing environmental and social responsibilities in global logistics operations.

The course may involve case studies, real-world examples, and practical exercises to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of international logistics challenges and solutions. Additionally, with the dynamic nature of global trade, staying updated on the latest industry trends and emerging technologies is crucial for professionals in this field.
